Við leitum að sjúkraþjálfara í okkar góða hóp á Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri (SAk). Um er að ræða 75-100% ótímabundna stöðu og er staðan laus nú þegar eða eftir nánara samkomulagi.

Sjúkraþjálfarar við Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri starfa á bráðadeildum sjúkrahússins við Eyrarlandsveg og/eða á endurhæfingadeild. Vegna flutninga endurhæfingardeildar af Kristnesi verður nú annars vegar starfrækt legudeild endurhæfingar í húsnæði SAk á Eyrarlandsholti og hins vegar dag- og göngudeild utan spítalans. Þar mun fara fram þverfagleg endurhæfing á einstaklingsgrunni og/eða í hópum. Staðsetning starfs getur farið eftir áhugasviði umsækjenda.

Um er að ræða dagvinnu, vinnuvika starfsfólks í fullu starfi er nú 36 klst. Við það bætast stöku sinnum vaktir um helgar og á lögbundnum frídögum við bráðadeildir sjúkrahússins, sem greitt er aukalega fyrir og gefur aukna tekjumöguleika.

Starfið er fjölbreytt og býður upp á frábær tækifæri til að afla sér faglegrar og sérhæfðrar þekkingar og taka þátt í uppbyggingu dag- og göngudeildar á nýjum stað. Við tökum vel á móti nýju fólki og veitum góða aðlögun undir handleiðslu reyndra sjúkraþjálfara. Kjörið tækifæri fyrir reynslubolta sem og nýútskrifaða til að dýpka þekkingu og verða hluti af öflugri liðsheild.

Helstu verkefni og ábyrgð
Almenn vinna sjúkraþjálfara í þverfaglegu umhverfi

Fræðsla til sjúklinga og aðstandenda

Þverfaglegt samstarf innan deilda

Verkefni og ábyrgð eru í samræmi við reynslu

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS

title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

Applications may remain valid for up to six months from the publication date of the advertisement, in accordance with Icelandic Government Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertisement of vacant public positions, as amended.

title: Bookkeeper / Admin
employer: WATERFORD L.E.D.C. COMPANY LIMITED BY GUARANTEE
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The ideal candidate will be well-organised, detail-oriented and experienced in bookkeeping. Responsibilities include managing accounts payable and receivable, monitoring cash flow, maintaining accurate financial records and preparing clear financial reports. They will take initiative in problem-solving, manage their workload effectively, ensure accurate bookkeeping, and liaise with Management and the Board on all bookkeeping matters. Responsibilities: To maintain computerised bookkeeping records (BrightBooks). File and maintain bookkeeping records. Maintain a complete record of all cash transactions. Keep bookkeeping records for accounts payable and receivable: Recording and processing invoices. Monitoring and resolving aged debtors. Ensuring bills are paid on time. Communicating with suppliers as needed. Advising the Manager on cashflow. Report to the Manager and Board on procedural issues: Ensuring that all sales are receipted and accounted for. Ensuring all cash is fully accounted for and the cash register is properly closed out and recorded. Ensuring all accounts are complete and accurate. Ensuring all bookkeeping standards and legal requirements. Record grant and capital accounts correctly. Report on grant money receipts and allocated expenditure. Maintain asset register records. Record acquisitions and disposals. Work with the Board/Auditor to prepare annual depreciation and amortization entries. Record VAT paid for the Revenue Charities VAT Compensation Scheme. Record payroll correctly in the accounts. Reconcile bank accounts. Ensure monies are entered or spent from the correct company bank accounts. Prepare journal entry adjustments, for example for prepayments and accruals. Ensure tidy and accurate record keeping at all times. Reporting regularly (monthly/annually) to the Manager and Board, e.g.: Profit and Loss Balance Sheet Aged Debtors Present reports to the Board. Work with the Board and Auditors, as required, in the preparation of company annual accounts. Ensure timely processing of payroll (BrightPay). Maintain employee payroll records. Ensure payroll correctly matches staff roster records. Ensure payroll taxes are reported and paid on time. Make any required bank account adjustments to cover all payroll costs. Ensure that staff are paid on-time, weekly. Report to the Manager and Board as required on payroll records. File and maintain all company records. File and organise all digital invoices and statements. File and/or scan all paper records as appropriate. All other additional administrative tasks assigned by the manager i.e footfall recording, grant applications, asset registration etc. Provide regular updates to Management and the Board as required. The successful candidate may be required to undertake other duties necessary to support the effective operation of the centre. Qualifications Bookkeeping qualification and relevant experience - 1yr minimum in a similar role. Please note that this role is subject to CSP funding

description:

In this fulltime role, you will be supporting Individuals with complex communication needs and a range of hearing and/or sight loss, to live self-directed lives in homes in the community. In some cases, the Individuals you support may have physical and cognitive difficulties and behaviours that challenge. Key Responsibilities Facilitate and promote a person-centred approach, appropriate to the needs and wishes of the Service User Work with Service Users, to enable them live in a community of their choosing, facilitating their ongoing involvement in their interests and hobbies ensuring access to local resources Work with Service Users in a way that promotes safeguarding, equality, dignity, diversity and their rights Supporting Service Users in directing their own lives, ensuring positive risk taking, in an environment that reflects the comforts of home Supporting Service Users to enjoy the good things in life, make sense of their environment, learn new skills and maximise their independence Assist with cooking, cleaning, shopping and general domestic tasks in the Service User’s home Understand and facilitate Service User’s needs, using their preferred communication system Establish, through continuity of work with Service Users, trusting professional relationships Ensure respect of the Service User’s will and preference to take on new tasks ensuring a positive risk assessment is carried out Provide assistance with aspects of personal care, people handling, ensuring dignity, safe practices for Service User’s Accompany Service Users to appointments and other events Act as advocate for Service users, who may have difficulty in expressing their needs Support Service User’s to have meaningful relationships, keep in contact with family and friends and to develop their social networks if they choose to. Assist with keyworking Adopt a positive behaviour support approach to respond effectively to any potentially challenging situations Adhere to all ASC Policies, Employee Handbook and work practices Adhere to all relevant national policies, including (but not limited to) HIQA Standards, HSE Policies, safeguarding Adhere to procedures to maintain the Service User’s home to the appropriate standards Adhere to Health & Safety standards and ensure that the health and safety of each Service user is central Maintain a high level of infection prevention and control within the Service User’s home Report any health and safety issues to the Health and Safety officer Ask questions to check when unsure of protocols, share information with the team that has a direct impact on Service users, be clear and factual in communications Attend Team Meeting Complete daily logs and show respect to other team members Reach out to more experienced RSWs and learn from them Work collaboratively and supportively with the multi-disciplinary team Undertake duties as may be assigned by the Manager or Team Leader to support the care of Service users.

The School of Medicine seeks to appoint a 1.0 FTE Associate Professor in Digital Health, Artificial Intelligence and Society to provide academic leadership at a moment of profound technological transformation in healthcare and higher education. This is a strategic joint appointment between the School of Medicine and the University. The postholder will devote approximately half of their activity to establishing institutional capability in Digital Health, AI and Connected Health within medicine. The other half will be dedicated to a new university-wide initiative, currently in development, that will explore how artificial intelligence may fundamentally reshape learning, universities, knowledge creation and professional formation. The postholder will be expected to play a formative role in shaping this initiative from its earliest stages. Post status: Specific Purpose Contract This employment is not offered on an indefinite duration basis as the appointment is required to deliver a defined, specific and time-limited, programme to establish a university-wide ecosystem for responsible AI innovation in medicine, education and research. When the specific programme of work is completed, there will no longer be a need for the role. Hours of Post: Hours of work for academic staff are those as prescribed under Public Service Agreements. Any applications which are still in progress at the closing time on the specified closing date will be cancelled automatically by the system. Please see the Job Description below for this position. title: Special Care Worker Special Care Services - Ballydowd & Crannóg Nua Dublin
description:

The policy of Tusla Child and Family Agency is to enable children / young people to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. The Social Care Worker will provide care, protection, and support to vulnerable or dependent clients, individually or in groups, in conjunction with the wider multidisciplinary team and other relevant agencies. The primary aim is to provide intervention necessary to address the child / young person’s issues or the issues that are preventing them from living at home or in relative / foster care. S/he will ensure the welfare of those under his/her care and will act as an advocate as appropriate. Social Care Workers in a Residential setting work as part of a multidisciplinary team to provide care to service users. Children / young people may be referred to a residential setting for a number of reasons by the Social Work department e.g. family breakdown / separation, history of neglect, sexual / physical abuse, addiction or mental health issues. Residential care aims to provide a therapeutic care placement to service users who most often present with emotional or behavioural difficulties and cannot live with their own families. Applicants must by the closing date of application have the following: - Be registered in the Social Care Worker Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board maintained at CORU (or have entitlement to be registered and obtain registration prior to appointment). And - Maintain live annual registration on the Social Care Workers Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board at CORU. or *Hold one of the following qualifications and be committed to a pathway towards Social Care education: - Youth and Community work qualification - BA (Hons) Youth and Community Development - BA (Hons) Psychology - Addiction Studies (Level 7) - BA (Hons) Counselling and Addiction Studies - Disability Diploma (Primary Care) - Degree in Social Science (minimum Level 7) or equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction AND • Must have the requisite knowledge and ability (including a high standard of suitability and professional ability) for the proper discharge of the duties of the office. Main Duties and Responsibilities Working with Children • To participate in the development and implementation of Care and Placement Plans and to ensure appropriate recording of same • To promote the rights and responsibilities of each child/young person within the centre. • To promote physical, emotional, social and religious welfare of each young person in care. • To encourage attendance at school, training centres, medical and clinical appointments. • To be responsible for the organisation of personal documents, arrangements, information and finance on behalf of the young person. • To liaise with the parent, family, general services and other agencies on behalf of the young person.

title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
description: Per conto di LPM Prefabbricati (https://www.lpmpref.it/) storica azienda con presenza consolidata sul mercato italiano nella fabbricazione di prefabbricati di grandi dimensioni, ricerchiamo un* Geometra con circa 10 anni di esperienza per un ruolo di Responsabile di Commessa con forte presenza in cantiere. La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo e responsabilità principali: Assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Programmare gli step operativi giornalieri/settimanali, e seguire l'avanzamento dei lavori. Coordinamento squadre di cantiere e subappaltatori: organizzazione, controllo operatività, gestione comportamenti e standard (es. riduzione inefficienze). Interfaccia con clienti: gestione richieste e criticità con approccio pratico (es. rimodulare l'ordine di montaggio per rispettare esigenze del cliente senza perdere controllo su tempi/costi). Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Requisiti: Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). ~10 anni di esperienza in cantieri industriali con responsabilità di capocantiere, o responsabile operativo, o responsabile commessa. Preferibile esperienza in prefabbricati o provenienza da imprese di costruzioni Competenze di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte su Nord-Ovest Italia e occasionalmente Sud Francia. Leadership concreta e capacità di gestione del team, capacità di far rispettare regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottima relazione con clienti e stakeholder: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione, problem solving. Approccio pratico, orientato a risultato e affidabilità su tempi/consegne. Azienda: LPM Srl Area: Mondovì (CN) e dintorni - raggio 40-45 km Cantieri: Nord-Ovest Italia + occasionali trasferte Sud Francia Contratto: Tempo indeterminato - Full time RAL indicativa: 40.000-50.000 € (commisurata all'esperienza) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. description: Per una PMI italiana in forte crescita nell'ambito dell' automazione industriale, ricerchiamo la figura di un Sales Manager- Automazione Industriale per guidare l'evoluzione dell'area commerciale da modello 'imprenditoriale' a struttura scalabile e data-driven. La sfida Inserimento con affiancamento iniziale alla Direzione Commerciale, pensato come transizione concreta e rapida verso la guida dell'Area Sales. E' una persona che non si staccherà dal business, al contrario contribuirà direttamente insieme al team alla crescita e allo sviluppo commerciale dell'azienda. Responsabilità Coordinare e affiancare team commerciale interno e rete di agenti/partner nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità. Definire (con la Direzione) obiettivi, priorità e piano commerciale; monitorare avanzamento e scostamenti. Gestire e sviluppare direttamente alcuni clienti strategici. Identificare nuovi segmenti, casi d'uso e soluzioni da introdurre (approccio 'business development'). Promuovere l'uso del CRM e la qualità della pipeline (forecast, next step, copertura). Collaborare con Customer Service, area tecnica/servizi e marketing per garantire continuità end-to-end. Partecipare a fiere, eventi e visite presso clienti e partner. Migliorare processi commerciali (pricing, marginalità, standard offerta, governance sconti). Requisiti = 5 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, preferibilmente in contesti tecnici/industriali o vendita consulenziale. Utilizzo concreto del CRM per pipeline, attività e monitoraggio risultati. Capacità di contribuire a budget commerciale, lettura KPI e attivazione di azioni correttive. Buona padronanza di pricing, gestione offerte, scontistica e condizioni commerciali. Attenzione a marginalità e redditività, bilanciando crescita e tutela dei margini. Esperienza (anche su piccoli team) in coordinamento e leadership. Inglese buono (scritto e parlato). Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali. Plus: provenienza da automazione industriale, componentistica elettrica/elettronica, sicurezza industriale. Cosa offriamo Ruolo strategico con impatto diretto sulla crescita e sulla trasformazione organizzativa dell'area commerciale. Autonomia decisionale e confronto costante con la Direzione Generale. Inserimento nel board aziendale. Contesto giovane, collaborativo, orientato alla qualità e con cultura 'zero frizioni'. Team interno + rete agenti già attivi, da guidare e sviluppare. Conoscenza concreta della filiera satcom: operatori, capacità, segmenti di terra, terminali, gateway, provisioning, SLA, supporto e modelli di distribuzione. Titoli preferenziali Esperienza presso operatori satellitari, service provider satcom, distributori specializzati, aziende satellite IoT o integratori specializzati in connettività satellitare. Familiarità con modelli GEO/MEO/LEO, servizi MSS, satellite IoT, NTN, VSAT o connettività in aree remote. description: Il nostro Cliente è una solida realtà industriale specializzata nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni 'chiavi in mano' per diversi settori, con un posizionamento consolidato su commesse custom e forte attenzione a qualità, tempi e affidabilità esecutiva. Per potenziamento dell'area Engineering siamo stati incaricati di ricercare un/una Electrical Project Engineer. La risorsa, a riporto diretto dell'Engineering Manager, sarà responsabile della progettazione elettrica di macchinari e impianti su commessa, garantendo coerenza con le specifiche cliente e con i vincoli di tempi, costi e qualità. Opererà in stretta collaborazione con Project Manager, Site Supervisor e Buyer, contribuendo in modo concreto alla riuscita tecnica delle commesse e alla gestione proattiva delle criticità lungo l'intero ciclo di progetto (dalla definizione alla messa in servizio). Principali responsabilità: Raccogliere e analizzare input di progetto (contratto, specifiche tecniche, requisiti cliente) Impostare l'ingegneria di base (unifilari, schema di rete, device list, consumer list) in linea con le specifiche Redigere specifiche tecniche d'acquisto per materiali e componenti Gestire il rilascio delle distinte materiali e coordinare codifica/inserimento a sistema per attivare l'MRP Effettuare valutazioni tecniche dei fornitori e relativo follow-up Identificare componenti critici e definirne le specifiche per lo scouting acquisti Coordinare e verificare la progettazione svolta da studi esterni Segnalare tempestivamente criticità al Project Manager (impatti su tempi/costi) Predisporre report periodici su tempi e costi della progettazione Definire sequenze di montaggio per la manualistica, evidenziando procedure critiche Supportare montaggio e avviamento, assicurando continuità tecnica Contribuire al riesame tecnico post-collaudo e a iniziative di miglioramento continuo Competenze tecniche richieste: Diploma e/o Laurea in ambito Elettrotecnica/Elettroingegneria o equivalente Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in progettazione di impianti elettrici per infrastrutture/impianti complessi su commessa Utilizzo di AutoCAD e/o EPLAN (pre-planning e ingegneria basica) Conoscenza di Caneco BT o software equivalenti (es. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. description: Hai una mente analitica e ti appassiona lavorare con i dati? Cerchi lavoro in ambito finanziario? Nello specifico la risorsa si occuperà di redazione del budget annuale e forecast mensili, con analisi puntuale degli headcount e degli scostamenti, creazione di report e dashboard per il monitoraggio dei principali HR analytics (turnover, assenze, straordinari, ferie, ecc.); eseguirà inoltre registrazioni contabili e attività di supporto amministrativo-contabile connesse al costo del personale, supporto ai processi di Payroll, con focus su tematiche e quadrature legate ai costi del personale e alla loro corretta rappresentazione. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione. title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

Profilo ricercato Esperienza diretta e verificabile nel settore delle telecomunicazioni satellitari. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).

7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.
Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Tiekėjų paieška: metalo apdirbimo ir gamybos įmonės, statybos ir demontavimo objektai, laivų
remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.
Objektų apžiūra vietoje: kiek medžiagos, kokios rūšies ir būklės, ar ją reikės pjaustyti, kaip bus
kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.

Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.

Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.

Pareigybės paskirtis – veiklai, kuri susijusi su finansinės apskaitos vykdymu, Lopšelio-darželio pasirašytos buhalterinės apskaitos organizavimo sutarties su Kaišiadorių bendrųjų funkcijų tarnyba (toliau – Tarnyba) įgyvendinimui, sąmatų rengimui ir vykdymui, asignavimų likučių kontrolės užtikrinimui, strateginio ir metinio veiklos plano finansinės dalies pildymo ir kitoms, teisės aktuose nustatytoms, finansinio pobūdžio funkcijoms vykdyti.

ŠIAS PAREIGAS EINANČIO DARBUOTOJO FUNKCIJOS
    Šias pareigas einantis Darbuotojas vykdo šias funkcijas: rengia ir per Buhalterinės apskaitos organizavimo sutartyje (toliau – Sutartis) nustatytus terminus Lopšelio-darželio direktoriui teikia apskaitai tvarkyti reikalingus apskaitos dokumentus, nurodydamas sumas ir kitą Lopšelio-darželio apskaitai tvarkyti reikalingą ir/ar Tarnybos prašomą informaciją, kuria pagrindžiamos vykdomos ūkinės operacijos;
7.2. iš atsakingo asmens gavęs atitinkamą informaciją, susijusią su turto valdymu, naudojimu, disponavimu, rengia ir nustatytais terminais pateikia Tarnybai dokumentus:
7.2.1. dėl ilgalaikio turto naudingo tarnavimo laiko, likvidacinės vertės nustatymo;
7.2.2. dėl turto pripažinimo netinkamu naudoti;

7.2.4. dėl inventorizacijos metu rasto turto vertės nustatymo ar nuvertinimo;
7.3. koordinuoja metinės turto inventorizacijos atlikimą;

7.5. patvirtinus savivaldybės biudžetą, rengia sąmatas bei pateikia programoje „FinNet“;
7.6. laiku ir laikantis teisės aktų inicijuoja biudžeto išlaidų klasifikacijos straipsnių patikslinimus / pakeitimus, rengia raštų dėl asignavimų paskirties keitimo projektus;
7.7. rengia įsakymų dėl asignavimų perkėlimo projektus;

7.9. informuoja Lopšelio-darželio direktorių apie Lopšelio-darželio lėšų likučius pagal atskirus šaltinius.

title: Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (m/f)
description:
Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1167

Apply Now

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your Key Objectives:

You will be responsible for implementing the Bank's commercial strategy and risk policy within the Alternative Funds segment, both in Luxembourg and abroad. You will manage and develop profitable client relationships, promote the Institutional Banking Value Proposition, and contribute to the growth of the Alternative Investment Funds business.

Your next challenge:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of clients in the Custodian Banking/Depositary segment and foster long-term relationships through regular client interactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients within BIL, ensuring effective coordination between clients and all relevant internal stakeholders.
• Achieve assigned objectives in terms of revenue, costs, deposit collection and credit production, while actively contributing to the performance of the Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team and Institutional Banking (IB).
• Promote the IB Value Proposition by developing a thorough understanding of clients' situations and proposing solutions that address their current and future needs.
• Maintain a strong knowledge of BIL's products and services, particularly those dedicated to AIF clients.
• Leverage the expertise available across IB to deliver comprehensive client solutions, drive cross-selling initiatives and identify business growth opportunities in collaboration with the Business Developers.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements, including KYC and AML obligations.
• Oversee the operational follow-up of client requests and instructions, working closely with the Business Office and Compliance teams to ensure service quality and efficiency.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing and training initiatives within Institutional Banking by supporting colleagues and continuously developing specialized expertise.
• Act as an ambassador of the BIL Group through participation in conferences, presentations, training sessions and industry events, while maintaining a strong professional network.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of products and services for AIF clients through an innovative and client-focused approach.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum 5 to 7 years of experience in the banking, fund industry and/or depositary environment.
• Excellent understanding of the AIFMD framework and the related legal and regulatory environment.
• In-depth knowledge of alternative asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Estate and Infrastructure.
• Extensive understanding of banking activities, organisational structures, operational risk management processes and control frameworks.
• Solid knowledge of banking products and services, including cash and treasury management, securities services, financing and capital markets solutions.
• Proven experience in operational risk assessment, process enhancement and monitoring activities.
• Good understanding of the key drivers and market dynamics of the European fund industry.
• Strong analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
• Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative approach.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

title: Expert en Communications Unifiées (m/f)
description:
Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) – CDI temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions. Telkea Group est à la recherche d'un Expert en Communications Unifiées

Missions

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Alcatel & NetPBX de Telkea ICT en tant qu'Expert en Communications Unifiées, avec une spécialisation sur les environnements Alcatel- Lucent Enterprise.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions : analyse des besoins, conception, installation, configuration, mise en production, maintenance, support et amélioration continue.

Vous serez également amené à évoluer progressivement vers les technologies de notification serveur (Mobicall), d'appel malade et de communication dans les environnements de soins, ou à mettre directement à profit une expérience existante dans ces domaines.

Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous interviendrez sur les plateformes de Telkea ICT ainsi que chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous serez un interlocuteur technique privilégié et contribuerez à garantir la qualité des installations, la continuité de service et la satisfaction de nos clients.

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à ;

• Réaliser les nouvelles installations et mises en service de solutions Alcatel OXE/Rainbow ;
• Installer, configurer et maintenir les systèmes de téléphonie et de communications unifiées ;
• Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 et 3 ;
• Traiter quotidiennement les tickets MACD — Move, Add, Change, Delete — ainsi que les incidents et pannes ;
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés à la téléphonie, aux réseaux, à la signalisation SIP et aux flux audio ;
• Assurer l'installation, la configuration et le support des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade ;
• Participer à l'intégration des solutions d'appel malade avec les environnements téléphoniques et les systèmes clients ;
• Évoluer vers une expertise complète des solutions de notification serveur, d'appel malade et de communication destinées aux établissements de soins ;
• Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des infrastructures installées ;
• Participer aux migrations, montées de version et évolutions techniques des plateformes ;
• Assurer la permanence technique selon un système de roulement ;
• Prendre en charge le suivi administratif et technique des projets ;
• Mettre à jour la base de données et la documentation des clients ;
• Rédiger les rapports d'intervention, dossiers techniques, procédures et documents d'exploitation ;
• Produire et maintenir les documentations de configuration et les dossiers « as-built » ;
• Assurer une communication technique claire et professionnelle avec les clients ;
• Collaborer avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les autres intervenants des projets ;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes, procédures et outils internes ;
• Développer régulièrement vos compétences techniques ;
• Respecter les exigences de qualité, de confidentialité et de service propres à la clientèle de Telkea ICT.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans un rôle similaire, dans le domaine des télécommunications, des communications unifiées, des réseaux ou des systèmes d'appel malade.

Vous avez une large culture technique et êtes capable d'intervenir sur des solutions dans leur ensemble, depuis l'installation et la configuration jusqu'au dépannage avancé et au support client.

Une expérience ou des connaissances dans les domaines suivants sont particulièrement appréciées:

• Solutions de téléphonie Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise ;
• Plateformes Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise et/ou OXO ;
• Téléphonie IP, SIP, VoIP et trunks opérateurs ;
• Réseaux IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solutions de notification serveur Solutions Mobicall ou technologies équivalentes ;
• Solutions d'appel malade et environnements hospitaliers ou résidentiels ;
• Intégration entre systèmes de téléphonie, DECT, systèmes de recherche de personnes et dispositifs d'alerte ;
• Supervision, ticketing et outils de diagnostic réseau.

Compétences:

• Expertise des environnements de téléphonie (la connaissance d'Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OXE et Rainbow constitue un atout) ;
• Bonne maîtrise de la téléphonie IP et du protocole SIP ;
• Solides bases en réseaux TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solides bases systèmes Windows, Linux et virtualisation ;
• Capacité à analyser des traces et captures réseau, notamment à l'aide de Wireshark ;
• Expérience en installation, configuration et dépannage de systèmes complexes ;
• La connaissance des environnements DECT et des solutions de mobilité Rainbow constitue un atout ;
• La connaissance des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade constitue un atout ;
• Capacité à comprendre les flux d'alerte, de notification, d'acquittement et d'escalade ;
• Aptitude à rédiger des documents techniques clairs et structurés ;
• Sensibilité aux aspects de sécurité, de disponibilité et de continuité de service ;
• La connaissance d'outils de supervision et de gestion des tickets est appréciée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

A propos de Telkea Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, Telkea Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et
les Institutions européennes.

Telkea Group (Telkea ICT, Telkea Security, Telkea Telecom et Telkea Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.

Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus ? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse : jobs@telkea.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».

Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

title: Group PMO (m/f)
description:
We are a 100% independent, family-owned Luxembourgish company with over 175 years' experience in the fast-moving consumer goods industry (tobacco products, smoking accessories, vaping, CBD and other nicotine products such as nicotine pouches). Within a dynamic environment towards more reduced risk products, we have embarked on an innovative journey to further strengthen our position in Europe, to grow worldwide and to enter new nicotine categories.

To support our current growth, we are looking for a :

Group PMO (Project Management Officer) (m/f/x)

Hollerich - Luxembourg

In this position, you will be responsible for establishing, coordinating, and continuously improving the Group project and program management framework. The role provides governance, standards, transparency, reporting, prioritization support, and delivery assurance across strategic initiatives, ensuring that projects are aligned with Group objectives, resources are used effectively, risks are escalated appropriately, and executive decisions are supported by reliable information. This role applies to all Group projects and programs, excluding IT-specific initiatives.

Your Responsibilities:

• Define, maintain, and improve the Group PMO framework, including project governance, methodologies, templates, standards, tools, and reporting practices.
• Support the prioritization, selection, and monitoring of Group projects and programs in line with strategic objectives, business value, capacity, and risk profile.
• Provide portfolio-wide visibility on project status, milestones, resources, budgets, risks, dependencies, issues, and benefits realization.
• Prepare consolidated executive dashboards, portfolio reports, steering committee materials, decision papers, and escalation summaries.
• Coordinate governance bodies and project review cycles, ensuring clear decision-making, action follow-up, and timely escalation of critical topics.
• Support project and program managers with planning discipline, delivery methodology, risk management, dependency management, and issue resolution processes.
• Monitor portfolio performance and challenge inconsistencies, gaps, delays, budget deviations, or unclear ownership across initiatives.
• Promote consistent project management practices, continuous improvement, simplification, and standardization across the Group.
• Facilitate alignment between business units, functions, and local entities to ensure coordinated execution of Group priorities.
• Develop internal PMO capabilities, knowledge sharing, project management maturity, and best practices across the organization.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
• Minimum 10 years of experience in project management, program coordination, portfolio management, PMO, business transformation, consulting, or a related role.
• Proven experience in establishing or operating PMO frameworks in an international, multi- function, or multi-entity environment.
• Strong understanding of project governance, portfolio reporting, planning, budgeting, risk management, resource management, and benefits tracking.
• Experience preparing executive-level reporting and supporting steering committees or senior management decision-making.
• Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, PgMP, PfMP, or equivalet are considered an advantage.
• Fluent English is required, additional languages relevant to the Group's footprint are an asset.

What We Offer:

• An exciting opportunity to join an international and growing industrial group.
• A key role within a strategic and innovative product category.
• A collaborative environment focused on performance, development, and continuous improvement.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.
• Professional growth opportunities within the Landewyck Group.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

In the context of recruitment, criminal record no. 3 will be requested.
