title: Launch MBA Program (m/f)
description:
Launch MBA Program
Job ID: 10552919 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Launch - Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. While we will consider location preferences if possible, we ask you to be as location-agnostic as possible since you may receive an offer from any of these corporate locations. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

title: Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team (m/f)
description:
Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team

Location  Leudelange
Experience Level  Experienced
Home Office  Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

• Within our International Non-Life department, we are building a new Pan-European business branch operating under the Freedom of Service (FoS) regime.
• Our ambition: bring innovative insurance solutions to B2B partners across Europe — from MGAs and brokers to corporate clients seeking fronting solutions for their captives.
• As Data and Process Manager, you will play a key role in structuring and supervising the entire data process exchange for our international operations.
• You will also be in charge of building processes and optimizing them to create the most efficient organization. You will ensure that data provided by third-party are handled efficiently, compliantly, and in line with Baloise's best practices — a cornerstone of our competitiveness.
• You will work within a multidisciplinary international team operating in start-up and agile mode, reporting directly to the Head of International Non-Life.
• You will be part of an international team shaping a new line of business within a stable and reputable insurance group, with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our European growth story.

What you can expect

Your main missions will be to:

Financial Management and Data Quality:

• Manage operational financial flows and work closely with Finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate transmission of data.
• Ensure the consistency and reliability of technical and financial data, notably by overseeing proper data reconciliation with actuarial teams and collaborating with partners to enhance the integrity of incoming data flows.

Operational and Cross-Functional Support:

• Coordinate operations across internal teams and external partners.
• Support claims management, fraud investigations, and customer complaints handling, while assisting in the design and deployment of operational processes with partners.
• Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders whenever required.
• Take ownership of cross-functional topics and urgent requests that have not yet been allocated within the team, stepping in where necessary to ensure business continuity and the successful delivery of activities across functions.
Process Management and Cross-Functional Coordination:
• Define, formalize, document, and continuously improve business processes, including underwriting, claims management, data flows, and reporting.
• Actively manage workflow automation and digitalization initiatives in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
• Ensure that processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Identify operational pain points and drive problem-solving and process optimization initiatives.
• Act as a central coordination point between operational teams, IT, Finance, and external partners.
• Foster collaboration and ensure seamless coordination across teams to address operational challenges.
• Ensure the timely implementation of IT solutions with our partners and proactively remove any delivery blockers.
• Contribute to the implementation or enhancement of tools and systems supporting operational management.
• Identify opportunities for operational improvement and lead process optimization projects.

What we expect

• Master's degree (or equivalent, Bac+5) in Management, Engineering, Finance, Insurance, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a cross-functional role, with exposure to operational processes, technology, finance, data management, and business operations
• Proven experience in an international and/or multi-country environment is highly desirable
• Strong organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills, with a continuous improvement mindset
• Proven ability to thrive in complex, multicultural environments, ideally within agile or fast-growing organizations.
• Fluency in English (working language); additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) are an asset
• SQL language proficiency

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

title: Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies (m/f)
description:
Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies
Job ID: 10566721 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

As an engineer on our team, you will take on a key role in improving capabilities of the Amazon product search service, and ensure we offer top-quality recommendations for all our customers regardless of their location or language. We help customers find the products they are searching for, and discover new products they would be interested in, by developing ML models trained on terabytes of product and traffic data to improve query understanding, ranking of search results, and personalization. We are seeking a software engineer who will assist in deploying those ML models, integrating them into existing services, and optimizing their performance. You will do so by building robust pipelines to train, evaluate, and deploy our models.

This is a rewarding role where you will be able to draw a clear connection between your work and how it improves the experience of millions of Amazon customers across the globe every day. You can also expect to have excellent opportunities, and ample support, for career growth, development, and mentorship. The team is a mixed science/engineering group, with each team member able to contribute to both engineering excellence as well as scientific innovation.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement new features across the various software components powering our search system
- Participate in the design and deployment of robust and scalable pipelines for data processing, model training, and model inference
- Build and configure metrics, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms for our deployed services and models
- Work closely with ML experts on your team to identify improvement opportunities and tackle technical obstacles
- Coordinate with engineering counterparts in other teams and stakeholders we work with

A day in the life

You will collaborate with scientists who build ML models trained on terabytes of data, and integrate these models into the production search engine that serves customers, closing the loop through design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. The chosen approaches for model architecture will balance business-defined performance metrics with the needs of millisecond response times.

About the team

EU International Technologies is an organization focused on accelerating the EU Stores business by delighting customers and selling partners. The team's mission is to innovate locally and scale worldwide, fostering a world-class community of builders that delivers with speed and agility. EU INTech operates across domains including consumer discovery, search, selection, partner growth, pricing, sustainability, and marketplace expansion. The culture emphasizes collaboration, inclusion, technical excellence, big bets on high-impact projects, transparency, and long-term ownership -- empowering engineers and scientists to solve complex problems at international scale.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years of professional software development experience
- 1+ year of experience in building large-scale pipelines for data processing and ML model training/inference
- Strong coding and problem-solving skills in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Java, C++, etc.
- A general understanding of essential machine learning concepts (with no expectation of in-depth ML knowledge)
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including code reviews, build processes, testing, and deployment

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- Professional experience with AWS services (e.g. S3, EC2, Lambda, EMR, DynamoDB)
- Prior experience within a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers
- Experience with NLP applications or search/retrieval engines
- Fluency in one or more languages other than English

title: Launch MBA Program (m/f)
description:
Launch MBA Program
Job ID: 10552798 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Launch - Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. While we will consider location preferences if possible, we ask you to be as location-agnostic as possible since you may receive an offer from any of these corporate locations. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

title: Secrétaire Département Inspection (m/f)
description:
Secrétaire Département Inspection

Location
Leudelange
Experience Level
Professionnels
Home Office
Oui

Votre job en bref

Au sein du Département Inspection, la fonction de Secrétaire contribue au bon déroulement des activités d'expertise Automobile en assurant l'organisation et la planification des interventions, le suivi administratif des dossiers et expertises, ainsi que la coordination des échanges avec les différentes parties prenantes.

Ce qui vous attend

Organisation et planification : 

• Trier et dispatcher les emails ainsi que les tâches dans le système « BIS » quotidiennement 
• Organiser et suivre les tournées d'expertises des inspecteurs DAB et Auto 
• Gérer l'agenda des différentes équipes Auto, DAB et CES
• Planifier les rendez-vous pour les dossiers « expertise valeur agréée » 

Accueil client et gestion des communications : 

• Assurer la permanence téléphonique pour les trois équipes Inspection
• Accueillir les clients au guichet pour des dossiers spécifiques ou en perte totale, appliquer la procédure « cocooning » et suivre les documents correspondants  
• Faire le relais avec les services transverses, agents, courtiers et intervenants externes pour les missions confiées 

Suivi des missions d'expertise et gestion des dossiers : 

• Gérer le dispatch des missions d'expertises DAB et Auto 
• Préparer les dossiers pour la cellule CES 
• Suivre les missions confiées à des cabinets externes, au niveau national et international 
• Assurer le suivi et le rapatriement des véhicules pour les dossiers spécifiques 
• Gérer l'envoi et suivi des clefs pour analyse dans le cadre des missions vol 

Suivi administratif et facturation : 

• Suivre et relancer les factures et rapports auprès des réparateurs et bureaux d'expertise externes 
• Relancer les bureaux d'expertise externes pour l'envoi des rapports 
• Relancer les clients pour obtenir les documents demandés 
• Relancer et suivre les paiements et documents auprès des épavistes 
• Gérer le suivi de la gestion de la flotte automobile pour les employés Baloise en collaboration avec le service Ressources Humaines

D'autres activités et responsabilités s'ajoutant à celles mentionnées ci-dessus peuvent être confiées au titulaire de la fonction.  

Ce que nous attendons

Niveau d'étude/de formation et expérience(s) pour accéder à la fonction :

• Diplôme/Formation : titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac en secrétariat, secrétariat de Direction, assistance administrative ou équivalent
• Expérience(s) requise(s) : 1 à 3 ans d'expérience sur une fonction similaire

Compétences techniques :

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques notamment le pack office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook, OneNote) et Teams  
• Bonnes qualités rédactionnelles
• Gestion administrative et gestion d'agendas  
• Compétences en outils de gestion (ex : ERP)
• Recyclage régulier « métier » demandé

Compétences comportementales :  

• Organisation et rigueur  
• Autonomie, engagement et bon esprit d'équipe  
• Aisance relationnelle et capacité à mener des conversations difficiles avec diplomatie  
• Orientation résultat et orientation client  
• Intégrité et discrétion

Compétences linguistiques :  

• Français et Anglais courant
• L'allemand et le luxembourgeois sont considérés comme un atout

À propos de Baloise

title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager*in

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

Notre client propose un environnement de travail où l'autonomie et l'engagement sont reconnus et valorisés.

Operations and controls

Delivery of services

• Manage administrative tasks by the team including regulatory filings, RBE register updates, RCS deposits, document execution and safekeeping and legalisation processes;

Client relationship management

• Responsible for a strategically significant client relationship, with a complex portfolio of underlying clients and stakeholders, including relationship development and ensuring high-quality service;

Team leadership

• Manage and oversee team performance and the team's operations, monitoring and directing activity within the team and ensuring delivery within the team's specified timeframes and procedures;
• Provide guidance, training and mentorship to team members and members of the wider Corporate Secretarial Services team;
• Support recruitment efforts for the teams in Luxembourg and the wider Corporate Secretarial team;

• You have a strong knowledge of Luxembourg corporate and fund regulations;
• You have excellent communication skills and attention to detail;

• Une expérience dans l'éditique ainsi que la maîtrise des environnements Linux (Red Hat) constituent un atout.

Convaincu·es que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

title: Senior Corporate Officer (m/f)
description:
Senior Corporate Officer

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a (Senior) Corporate Officer!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing.

At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships.
With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees.
Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As a (Senior) Corporate Officer, you will be responsible for the corporate governance and company secretarial duties of a portfolio of Luxembourg investment funds - including RAIFs, SIFs, SICAVs - and related corporate vehicles.
You will contribute to the success of high-profile structures in a fast-paced and evolving regulatory environment, while acting as a key contact person and ensuring full compliance with Luxembourg corporate law and governance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage the full corporate lifecycle of Luxembourg funds and related entities (establishment, board/AGM/EGM, capital changes, liquidation, etc.).
• Organise and coordinate board meetings and general meetings, including the preparation of agendas, convening notices, board packs, resolutions and minutes.
• Draft legal and corporate documents: board and shareholder resolutions, proxies, minutes, certificates, and service agreements.
• Contribute to maintaining and updating statutory registers (shareholders and investors).
• Ensure timely filings with Luxembourg authorities (RCS, MyGuichet, eCDF) and compliance with legal obligations (RBE and similar).
• Liaise with notaries, external legal counsels, auditors, banks, and regulatory bodies (CSSF if necessary).
• Monitor and stay ahead of the regulatory developments (AML/KYC, DAC6, ESG, where necessary) and ensure proactive compliance.
• Support corporate transactions of clients including reorganisations, capital increases, mergers, and financing.
• Supervise junior officers and review their work as needed.
• Collaborate on internal projects to enhance corporate governance and process efficiency.

This offer is for you if:

• University degree in Law, Corporate Law, or equivalent.
• 2 to 4 years of experience in a similar role in Luxembourg within a fiduciary, PSF, law firm, asset manager or corporate services provider.
• Strong knowledge of the Luxembourg Company Law (1915 Law) and relevant regulations.
• Familiarity with various corporate structures: SIF, RAIF, SICAV, SPV, partnerships.
• Sound understanding of AML/KYC obligations and CSSF requirements.
• Fluency in English and French (spoken and written) is required.
• Knowledge of German or Luxembourgish is an asset.
• Rigorous and detail-oriented with excellent organisational skills.
• Able to work autonomously and manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
• Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

What's in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

--

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: Expert en Communications Unifiées (m/f)
description:
Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) – CDI temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions. Telkea Group est à la recherche d'un Expert en Communications Unifiées

Missions

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Alcatel & NetPBX de Telkea ICT en tant qu'Expert en Communications Unifiées, avec une spécialisation sur les environnements Alcatel- Lucent Enterprise.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions : analyse des besoins, conception, installation, configuration, mise en production, maintenance, support et amélioration continue.

Vous serez également amené à évoluer progressivement vers les technologies de notification serveur (Mobicall), d'appel malade et de communication dans les environnements de soins, ou à mettre directement à profit une expérience existante dans ces domaines.

Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous interviendrez sur les plateformes de Telkea ICT ainsi que chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous serez un interlocuteur technique privilégié et contribuerez à garantir la qualité des installations, la continuité de service et la satisfaction de nos clients.

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à ;

• Réaliser les nouvelles installations et mises en service de solutions Alcatel OXE/Rainbow ;
• Installer, configurer et maintenir les systèmes de téléphonie et de communications unifiées ;
• Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 et 3 ;
• Traiter quotidiennement les tickets MACD — Move, Add, Change, Delete — ainsi que les incidents et pannes ;
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés à la téléphonie, aux réseaux, à la signalisation SIP et aux flux audio ;
• Assurer l'installation, la configuration et le support des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade ;
• Participer à l'intégration des solutions d'appel malade avec les environnements téléphoniques et les systèmes clients ;
• Évoluer vers une expertise complète des solutions de notification serveur, d'appel malade et de communication destinées aux établissements de soins ;
• Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des infrastructures installées ;
• Participer aux migrations, montées de version et évolutions techniques des plateformes ;
• Assurer la permanence technique selon un système de roulement ;
• Prendre en charge le suivi administratif et technique des projets ;
• Mettre à jour la base de données et la documentation des clients ;
• Rédiger les rapports d'intervention, dossiers techniques, procédures et documents d'exploitation ;
• Produire et maintenir les documentations de configuration et les dossiers « as-built » ;
• Assurer une communication technique claire et professionnelle avec les clients ;
• Collaborer avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les autres intervenants des projets ;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes, procédures et outils internes ;
• Développer régulièrement vos compétences techniques ;
• Respecter les exigences de qualité, de confidentialité et de service propres à la clientèle de Telkea ICT.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans un rôle similaire, dans le domaine des télécommunications, des communications unifiées, des réseaux ou des systèmes d'appel malade.

Vous avez une large culture technique et êtes capable d'intervenir sur des solutions dans leur ensemble, depuis l'installation et la configuration jusqu'au dépannage avancé et au support client.

Une expérience ou des connaissances dans les domaines suivants sont particulièrement appréciées:

• Solutions de téléphonie Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise ;
• Plateformes Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise et/ou OXO ;
• Téléphonie IP, SIP, VoIP et trunks opérateurs ;
• Réseaux IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solutions de notification serveur Solutions Mobicall ou technologies équivalentes ;
• Solutions d'appel malade et environnements hospitaliers ou résidentiels ;
• Intégration entre systèmes de téléphonie, DECT, systèmes de recherche de personnes et dispositifs d'alerte ;
• Supervision, ticketing et outils de diagnostic réseau.

Compétences:

• Expertise des environnements de téléphonie (la connaissance d'Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OXE et Rainbow constitue un atout) ;
• Bonne maîtrise de la téléphonie IP et du protocole SIP ;
• Solides bases en réseaux TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solides bases systèmes Windows, Linux et virtualisation ;
• Capacité à analyser des traces et captures réseau, notamment à l'aide de Wireshark ;
• Expérience en installation, configuration et dépannage de systèmes complexes ;
• La connaissance des environnements DECT et des solutions de mobilité Rainbow constitue un atout ;
• La connaissance des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade constitue un atout ;
• Capacité à comprendre les flux d'alerte, de notification, d'acquittement et d'escalade ;
• Aptitude à rédiger des documents techniques clairs et structurés ;
• Sensibilité aux aspects de sécurité, de disponibilité et de continuité de service ;
• La connaissance d'outils de supervision et de gestion des tickets est appréciée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

A propos de Telkea Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, Telkea Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et

title: Experienced Deal Advisory Analyst (m/f)
description:
Experienced Deal Advisory Analyst

BDO Luxembourg is looking for an Experienced Deal Advisory Analyst!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

Being part of the team, you will:

• Perform buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements for acquisitions, disposals, mergers, and strategic investments;
• Analyze historical financial information and assess the quality of earnings, working capital requirements, net debt position, cash flow generation, and key business drivers;
• Identify transaction risks, value creation opportunities, and potential deal breakers;
• Prepare detailed due diligence reports, executive summaries, and client presentations;
• Review financial statements, management accounts, budgets, forecasts, and business plans;
• Participate in management meetings and interviews with target company executives;
• Support clients throughout the transaction process, including SPA considerations and deal negotiations;
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including valuation, tax, legal, restructuring, and M&A advisory professionals;
• Mentor and coach junior team members where applicable.

This position is for you if:

• You hold a Master's degree in business administration and economics, ideally with a Corporate Finance specialization;
• You have between 3 to 5 years of significant experience in Deal Advisory Services (mainly due diligence);
• You aim to continue learning;
• You aim to be a well-rounded Deal Advisory professional;
• You are proactive, involved, highly motivated and take responsibility for your own work;
• You possess strong analytical and communication skills;
• You are fluent in French and possess a good English level. German and Luxembourgish are considered a plus, any other additional European language can be an asset.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

--

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: SCIENTIFIC DIRECTOR (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
CEO-26003 SCIENTIFIC DIRECTOR

Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is Luxembourg's national research and innovation centre focused on natural sciences, engineering, and emerging technologies. As a multidisciplinary Research and Technology Organisation (RTO), LIST delivers high-impact research in materials, environment, information technologies, and space resources, advancing Luxembourg's ambition to be a leading knowledge-based, sustainable and resilient economy.

LIST is now seeking an outstanding and forward-thinking Scientific Director to join its Executive Committee and drive the organisation's next phase of scientific excellence. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Scientific Director will play a pivotal role in further strengthening LIST's position as a world-leading multidisciplinary RTO.

The ideal candidate is a globally recognised scientific leader with a distinguished track record in research and innovation aligned with LIST's research portfolio. You will bring a bold vision for scientific advancement, a commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, and the leadership capabilities to drive research that creates meaningful societal and economic impact. The role requires a PhD in natural sciences or engineering, global scientific recognition, and at least 15 years of experience in research and innovation, including a minimum of 5 years in senior leadership, preferably within an RTO or a similar research-intensive organisation. Fluency in English and French is essential.

At LIST, you will join a mission-driven, multicultural community, supported by outstanding facilities, strong European partnerships, and a culture committed to sustainability, diversity, and innovation.

Application procedure and conditions

Your application must include a motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience and a detailed CV.
1. LIST is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to hiring and retaining diverse personnel. LIST value all applicants and will consider all competent candidates for employment without regard to national origin, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age or disability.

2. An assessment committee will review the applications and select candidates based on guidelines that aim to ensure equal opportunities.

3. The main criteria for selection will be the correspondence of the existing skills, expertise and experience of the applicant with the requirements mentioned within the job description.

4. As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements.

5. For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

An executive search exercise is being undertaken by Perrett Laver who will support the Luxembourg Institute of Science & Technology in identifying a field of qualified candidates and assist in their assessment against the requirements for the role. For informal enquiries about the role please contact Dr. Ismail Makroum Ismail.Makroum@perrettlaver.com. To apply, or to download further information on the required qualifications, skills, and experience for the role, please click below quoting reference 8160LIST in your application.

All applicants are strongly encouraged to submit their complete application by Wednesday 25th November for full consideration. However, applications will continue to be accepted until the position is filled.

title: Group PMO (m/f)
description:
We are a 100% independent, family-owned Luxembourgish company with over 175 years' experience in the fast-moving consumer goods industry (tobacco products, smoking accessories, vaping, CBD and other nicotine products such as nicotine pouches). Within a dynamic environment towards more reduced risk products, we have embarked on an innovative journey to further strengthen our position in Europe, to grow worldwide and to enter new nicotine categories.

To support our current growth, we are looking for a :

Group PMO (Project Management Officer) (m/f/x)

Hollerich - Luxembourg

In this position, you will be responsible for establishing, coordinating, and continuously improving the Group project and program management framework. The role provides governance, standards, transparency, reporting, prioritization support, and delivery assurance across strategic initiatives, ensuring that projects are aligned with Group objectives, resources are used effectively, risks are escalated appropriately, and executive decisions are supported by reliable information. This role applies to all Group projects and programs, excluding IT-specific initiatives.

Your Responsibilities:

• Define, maintain, and improve the Group PMO framework, including project governance, methodologies, templates, standards, tools, and reporting practices.
• Support the prioritization, selection, and monitoring of Group projects and programs in line with strategic objectives, business value, capacity, and risk profile.
• Provide portfolio-wide visibility on project status, milestones, resources, budgets, risks, dependencies, issues, and benefits realization.
• Prepare consolidated executive dashboards, portfolio reports, steering committee materials, decision papers, and escalation summaries.
• Coordinate governance bodies and project review cycles, ensuring clear decision-making, action follow-up, and timely escalation of critical topics.
• Support project and program managers with planning discipline, delivery methodology, risk management, dependency management, and issue resolution processes.
• Monitor portfolio performance and challenge inconsistencies, gaps, delays, budget deviations, or unclear ownership across initiatives.
• Promote consistent project management practices, continuous improvement, simplification, and standardization across the Group.
• Facilitate alignment between business units, functions, and local entities to ensure coordinated execution of Group priorities.
• Develop internal PMO capabilities, knowledge sharing, project management maturity, and best practices across the organization.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
• Minimum 10 years of experience in project management, program coordination, portfolio management, PMO, business transformation, consulting, or a related role.
• Proven experience in establishing or operating PMO frameworks in an international, multi- function, or multi-entity environment.
• Strong understanding of project governance, portfolio reporting, planning, budgeting, risk management, resource management, and benefits tracking.
• Experience preparing executive-level reporting and supporting steering committees or senior management decision-making.
• Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI, PRINCE2, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, PgMP, PfMP, or equivalet are considered an advantage.
• Fluent English is required, additional languages relevant to the Group's footprint are an asset.

What We Offer:

• An exciting opportunity to join an international and growing industrial group.
• A key role within a strategic and innovative product category.
• A collaborative environment focused on performance, development, and continuous improvement.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.
• Professional growth opportunities within the Landewyck Group.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

In the context of recruitment, criminal record no. 3 will be requested.

Do you recognize yourself in this description and do you want to know more about us? Then apply at recruitment@landewyck.com! The Landewyck adventure starts now!

Hollerich - Luxembourg

title: HR Business Partner (m/f)
employer: Sometimes, Sàrl - Crèches Rockids S.A R.L.
description:
HR Business Partner (M/W)

Rockids, a network of nurseries operated by the La Maison Bleue Group, supports children and their families every day through a caring, innovative educational approach focused on children's development. Rockids is a recognized leader in the early childhood sector and operates 24 small-scale centers across Luxembourg, where quality of care, educational excellence, and staff well-being are at the heart of every project.
Joining Rockids means becoming part of a leading international group in the early childhood sector while working within a local, close-knit organization.

As an HR Business Partner, you will help shape the company's HR practices, support managers in their day-to-day challenges, and foster a high-performing work environment that promotes employee development.

Your primary mission will be to support the company's growth by implementing and continuously improving the HR processes that underpin its development.

As a true partner to senior management and teams, you will work across a broad range of responsibilities, including recruitment, HR development, HR administration, project management, and employee relations.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

You will be responsible for the full recruitment process, from identifying staffing needs to onboarding new employees.
In this role, you will:

• Analyze hiring needs with facility directors and managers, taking into account staffing levels, operational requirements, and regulatory staff-to-resident ratios.
• Define candidate profiles and draft job descriptions and job postings.
• Post job openings and develop new recruitment channels.
• Proactively propose initiatives to strengthen the Group's attractiveness and employer brand.
• Conduct telephone pre-screenings for key roles across our facilities, including educational assistants, care assistants, educators, and facility managers.
• Conduct interviews and support managers throughout the recruitment process.
• Take a direct role in critical or sensitive hires and support less experienced managers in conducting interviews.
• Support newly appointed department heads as they develop their recruitment skills.
• Manage the administrative follow-up of applications.
• Coordinate the onboarding of new employees and monitor their probationary periods.

Supporting Managers and Teams

As a partner to managers and teams, you will support them in addressing their day-to-day HR challenges.

In particular, you will:

• Provide HR oversight and support to teams.
• Monitor and address absenteeism and turnover.
• Advise managers on disciplinary matters.
• Support skills development and employee development initiatives.
• Support the implementation of HR policies and procedures.
• Provide managers with practical HR advice tailored to operational realities and the specific needs of each location.

HR Administration

Working closely with our third-party service providers and internal teams, you will ensure the reliability and smooth execution of HR administrative processes.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Managing payroll processes, including preparing and submitting payroll data and generating monthly reports.
• Preparing employment contracts and contract amendments.
• Managing and maintaining the HRIS.
• Monitoring administrative procedures related to medical examinations and other regulatory requirements.
• Coordinating end-of-contract procedures.
• Maintaining relationships with our payroll service provider, government authorities, and other HR service providers.

HR Management and Reporting

You will contribute to the effective management of the HR function by producing and analyzing HR data.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Maintaining HR dashboards and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of HR data, including turnover and absenteeism figures.
• Analyzing key HR metrics related to absenteeism, turnover, recruitment, and payroll costs.
• Identifying trends and areas of concern and proposing appropriate corrective actions.
• Preparing HR reports and presentations for senior management.
• Developing new HR metrics and reporting tools based on the Group's needs.

HR Projects

You will play an active role in shaping and developing the Group's HR strategy and policies.

In particular, you will:

• Contribute to defining and implementing the HR strategy.
• Structure and continuously improve HR processes, particularly in the areas of recruitment and onboarding.
• Oversee the onboarding process for new employees.
• Implement and monitor training and skills development programs.
• Participate in interview campaigns and performance review processes.
• Contribute to the development of the employer brand and internal communications.
• Conduct employee engagement and satisfaction surveys, analyze the results, and propose action plans.
• Participate in discussions regarding salary structures and compensation, in collaboration with senior management.
• Support the implementation of new HR tools and processes.
• Proactively suggest initiatives to improve the employee experience.

Compliance and HR Monitoring

You will ensure compliance with the legal and regulatory framework applicable to the company and will:
• Monitor developments in employment law and HR regulations.
• Collaborate with our law firm and external partners on matters requiring specific expertise.
• Support management in handling sensitive individual employee situations.

Your Profile

We are looking for an HR professional with at least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR role or as an HR Business Partner, ideally in a multi-site environment.
You have a solid understanding of HR practices and are comfortable working across the key areas of the HR function.

Qualifications and Skills

You are known for:

• Your independence and strong sense of responsibility.
• Your ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Your attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Your analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as your ability to synthesize information.
• Your excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build trusting relationships with managers and colleagues.
• Your pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.
• Your discretion and commitment to confidentiality.
• Your ability to stay connected to operational realities while providing proactive insights and recommendations to senior management.

Technical Skills

• A higher education degree in Human Resources, Management, Employment Law, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR or HR Business Partner role.
• A strong understanding of employment law and operational HR practices.
• Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, including dashboards, KPI tracking, and reporting.
• Proficiency in digital tools and HR information systems (GesperPersonnel).
• Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken.
• Experience working in a multi-site environment is highly desirable.

Working Conditions

• Position based at Rockids' headquarters in Luxembourg, reporting directly to senior management.
• Flexible working hours, free meals and parking, company car, and performance-based bonus.

Why Join Us?

• Grow alongside a committed, multidisciplinary local leadership team at the heart of the company's governance and transformation.
• Join a leading international group in the early childhood sector with a strong local presence.
• Take on a position of responsibility offering genuine autonomy and a broad range of responsibilities.
• Gain cross-functional experience by working with teams across the La Maison Bleue Group in France, England, and Switzerland.

Nous offrons

title: Responsable Affaires Réglementaires et Institutionnelles (m/f)
description:
Responsable Affaires Réglementaires et Institutionnelles (M/F)

Rattaché(e) au Directeur Juridique et Compliance Groupe, vous assurez le suivi et l'analyse des évolutions législatives, réglementaires et jurisprudentielles susceptibles d'impacter les activités du Groupe.
Vous contribuez à la définition et à la mise en oeuvre des positions du Groupe dans le cadre des projets de loi, initiatives réglementaires et travaux des organisations professionnelles.
Véritable interface entre les enjeux juridiques, stratégiques et institutionnels, vous accompagnez la Direction Générale dans l'anticipation des évolutions du cadre normatif et dans ses relations avec les autorités, régulateurs et parties prenantes externes.

• Collaborer avec les équipes Juridique et Compliance, et animer des groupes de travail internes, sur les sujets de veille juridique et réglementaires.

Affaires publiques et représentation d'intérêts

• Analyser les projets de loi, règlements, consultations publiques, positions des autorités de supervision et initiatives des institutions nationales et européennes.
• Contribuer à la définition des positions du Groupe sur les sujets réglementaires stratégiques.
• Développer et entretenir un réseau de contacts auprès des parties prenantes institutionnelles et professionnelles.

Support à la Direction Générale

• Préparer les dossiers stratégiques, notes de synthèse, éléments de langage et argumentaires pour les réunions, interventions et prises de parole du CEO et du Directeur Juridique et Compliance Groupe.
