• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master 2 en droit ou économie.
• 5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans une fonction juridique, réglementaire, institutionnelle ou de représentation d'intérêts.
• Bonne connaissance du processus législatif luxembourgeois et européen.
• Excellentes capacités d'analyse juridique et réglementaire,
• Forte aptitude à synthétiser des sujets complexes à destination d'un public dirigeant.
• Compréhension des enjeux économiques, stratégiques et politiques entourant les évolutions réglementaires.
• Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelles, avec un souci de rigueur.
• Autonomie, curiosité intellectuelle et sens politique développé.
• Français et anglais courants, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral.

Notre offre :

Vous bénéficierez, entre autres, des avantages suivants :

• Un environnement de travail multiculturel, apprenant et innovant.
• Un système d'horaires flexible.
• Un restaurant d'entreprise à tarif préférentiel.

title: Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract (m/f)
description:
Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

The role?
At ISL, we believe our young learners are capable, curious and full of ideas. They learn through relationships, play, inquiry and meaningful exploration of the world around them. We are seeking a Lower School Classroom Teaching Assistant to assist our Grade 2 teachers (students ages 7-8) in creating caring, inclusive environments where every student feels a sense of belonging, develops agency and independence, and experiences the joy of learning.

Working in partnership with the classroom teacher and wider Lower School team, the Teaching Assistant is an important resource for students and parents.

What will you do?

Working alongside the Grade 2 classroom teachers, you will:

• help create a caring and inquiry-rich learning environment;
• support individuals and small groups during student-initiated and teacher-directed learning;
• encourage curiosity, communication, collaboration, creativity and problem-solving;
• observe and document students' learning and emerging needs;
• prepare materials and learning spaces that invite exploration;
• support arrival, dismissal, transitions, specialist lessons, lunch, playground and other daily routines;
• help children develop positive relationships, independence and a sense of responsibility; and
• supervise and accompany students during activities, field trips and other experiences beyond the classroom.

What skills do you bring?

We are interested in what you can do, how you work with others and your potential to learn and grow. Your skills may have been developed through education, employment, volunteering, or community activities.

You will be able to demonstrate your ability to:

• Build trusting relationships with young students, helping them feel safe, known and valued.
• Support learning through inquiry, using conversation, thoughtful questions and exploration to extend students' thinking.
• Notice and respond to learners, observing students and collaborating with the teachers to document learning and development.
• Foster agency and independence, knowing when to support, when to question and when to give students space to try for themselves.
• Support multilingual learners and communicate clearly and sensitively with students developing English as an additional language.
• Create inclusive environments that value different languages, cultures, experiences and ways of learning.
• Collaborate effectively with teachers and colleagues and build positive, professional relationships with
• families.
• Support students' wellbeing, relationships, routines, transitions and self-management in developmentally appropriate ways.
• Adapt and take initiative in the dynamic environment of a classroom.
• Reflect and grow, welcoming feedback and taking responsibility for your own professional learning.

Who you are?

You genuinely enjoy being with young students and see them as capable learners. You are patient, curious, dependable and proactive. You understand that learning happens throughout the day—from a student's question to developing independence during routines or navigating a disagreement with a friend. You communicate thoughtfully, value different perspectives and cultures, and know that excellent support sometimes means stepping forward and sometimes stepping back.
Above all, you bring care, curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to helping every student participate, learn and belong.
Our commitment to students
Through this role, you will support ISL's Strategic Plan by helping deliver a Lower School programme that meets high creative and academic standards and enables students to be active, engaged and successful learners.
ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects you to share this commitment. title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

description:
HR Business Partner (M/W)

Rockids, a network of nurseries operated by the La Maison Bleue Group, supports children and their families every day through a caring, innovative educational approach focused on children's development. Rockids is a recognized leader in the early childhood sector and operates 24 small-scale centers across Luxembourg, where quality of care, educational excellence, and staff well-being are at the heart of every project.
Joining Rockids means becoming part of a leading international group in the early childhood sector while working within a local, close-knit organization.

As an HR Business Partner, you will help shape the company's HR practices, support managers in their day-to-day challenges, and foster a high-performing work environment that promotes employee development.

Your primary mission will be to support the company's growth by implementing and continuously improving the HR processes that underpin its development.

As a true partner to senior management and teams, you will work across a broad range of responsibilities, including recruitment, HR development, HR administration, project management, and employee relations.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

You will be responsible for the full recruitment process, from identifying staffing needs to onboarding new employees.
In this role, you will:

• Analyze hiring needs with facility directors and managers, taking into account staffing levels, operational requirements, and regulatory staff-to-resident ratios.
• Define candidate profiles and draft job descriptions and job postings.
• Post job openings and develop new recruitment channels.
• Proactively propose initiatives to strengthen the Group's attractiveness and employer brand.
• Conduct telephone pre-screenings for key roles across our facilities, including educational assistants, care assistants, educators, and facility managers.
• Conduct interviews and support managers throughout the recruitment process.
• Take a direct role in critical or sensitive hires and support less experienced managers in conducting interviews.
• Support newly appointed department heads as they develop their recruitment skills.
• Manage the administrative follow-up of applications.
• Coordinate the onboarding of new employees and monitor their probationary periods.

Supporting Managers and Teams

As a partner to managers and teams, you will support them in addressing their day-to-day HR challenges.

In particular, you will:

• Provide HR oversight and support to teams.
• Monitor and address absenteeism and turnover.
• Advise managers on disciplinary matters.
• Support skills development and employee development initiatives.
• Support the implementation of HR policies and procedures.
• Provide managers with practical HR advice tailored to operational realities and the specific needs of each location.

HR Administration

Working closely with our third-party service providers and internal teams, you will ensure the reliability and smooth execution of HR administrative processes.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Managing payroll processes, including preparing and submitting payroll data and generating monthly reports.
• Preparing employment contracts and contract amendments.
• Managing and maintaining the HRIS.
• Monitoring administrative procedures related to medical examinations and other regulatory requirements.
• Coordinating end-of-contract procedures.

HR Management and Reporting

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Maintaining HR dashboards and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of HR data, including turnover and absenteeism figures.
• Analyzing key HR metrics related to absenteeism, turnover, recruitment, and payroll costs.
• Identifying trends and areas of concern and proposing appropriate corrective actions.
• Preparing HR reports and presentations for senior management.
• Developing new HR metrics and reporting tools based on the Group's needs.

HR Projects

In particular, you will:

• Contribute to defining and implementing the HR strategy.
• Structure and continuously improve HR processes, particularly in the areas of recruitment and onboarding.
• Oversee the onboarding process for new employees.
• Implement and monitor training and skills development programs.
• Participate in interview campaigns and performance review processes.
• Contribute to the development of the employer brand and internal communications.

• Support the implementation of new HR tools and processes.

• Monitor developments in employment law and HR regulations.
• Collaborate with our law firm and external partners on matters requiring specific expertise.
• Support management in handling sensitive individual employee situations.

You have a solid understanding of HR practices and are comfortable working across the key areas of the HR function.

Qualifications and Skills

• Your attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Your analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as your ability to synthesize information.

Working Conditions

Why Join Us?

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026

title: Senior Product Manager, EU FBA Supply Chain (m/f)
description:
Senior Product Manager, EU FBA Supply Chain
Job ID: 10561353 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Removals Seller Experience within EU FBA Supply Chain. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll define strategy and build the roadmap for the 250M+ units (7% of outbound) removed from our network annually, partnering with WW FBA, tech and science, fulfillment operations, and seller experience teams to durably reduce removals damages, improve removals speed, and deliver the consolidation and traceability sellers need.

You're analytical, curious, and relentless. You ask "why" five times, work across org boundaries with ease, and obsess over the seller and customer experience. You bring high judgment, deep conviction, and the grit to turn complex, cross-functional problems into durable solutions.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the removals SX roadmap. Define product and program strategy to overhaul the end-to-end removal experience, from order creation through FC processing, carrier handoff, and delivery. Prioritize across three core seller frictions (damages, speed, and consolidation/traceability), balancing seller trust against cost-to-serve and FC capacity guardrails.
• Bring EU voice to the S-Team working group. Serve as a key member of the cross-team working group with WW FBA and all partner teams to finalize the S-Team Removals overhaul goal and feeder goals. Own and deliver on the EU feeder goals, reporting progress through the working group's mechanisms.
• Eliminate defects, damages, and cancellations. Build mechanisms to identify and resolve recurring defects at the root cause. Own the strategy to reduce inaccurate removals from system gaps. Deliver Seller-facing tools for damage reporting, claims resolution, and proactive communication.
• Fix removals speed and traceability. Drive removal lead time reduction by partnering with FC Operations and enable end-to-end removal tracking so sellers have full visibility from order creation to delivery.
• Scale automated removals. Drive auto-removal adoption by defining the engagement tiers (default, agentic, guided self-service) and the guardrails that give sellers control while enabling automation.
• Be the metric and mechanism owner. Define, instrument, and reporting on Removals SX metrics. Decompose into actionable drivers and size each opportunity. Build the business case, write the narratives (PRFAQ, OP1/OP2 inputs, MBR/QBR updates), and manage the review cadence with senior leadership.

About the team

Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years. Sellers can list and sell their products across all of our European sites from a single account. This frees them to concentrate on what they do best - finding and developing new products and marketing them to potential customers.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience in problem solving and data analytics
- Experience in leading large, cross functional projects
- Experience presenting complex ideas in writing in the form of authoring white papers, proposals, or other formal strategy documents

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Master's degree or above in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science, or experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship

description:

Description

Launch - Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

description:
Network Planning Manager, MMNC - Middle Mile Network Control
Job ID: 10551620 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

This role tagged as one of Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to Retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Key job responsibilities

Define the Amazon outbound network planning (Legs, Sorts, CPT) for one of the UK sub-regions covered by 3-5 Sort Centers.
Analyse the best design based on forecast, and historical flows to improve cost, speed and DEA across E2E network.
Partner with teams to align on network changes to solve operational challenges.
Support the planning and organization of complex projects including Peak network transformations

A day in the life

Being a Network Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.

As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both on-the-ground tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.

This role is based in Luxembourg headquarters.

About the team

Amazon couldn't deliver at pace without the STEP TNO team. As part of STEP TNO MMNC, you'll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you'll help Amazon's transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.

We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience in supply chain

- Experience leading process improvements

- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f)
description:
Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f)

Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients.

Your role

• Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework.
• Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
• Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors).
• Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process.
• Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters.
• Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments.
• Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests.
• Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies.

Your skills and experience

• Master's degree in economics, finance, mathematics or a related field.
• At least 2 years of previous experience in risk management, control and/or audit functions.
• Good knowledge and understanding of the Luxembourg investment fund industry and the UCITS regulatory framework.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English; proficiency in French or Italian would be an asset.

Who we are

FundSight is an independent third-party Management Company (ManCo) based in Luxembourg, regulated by the CSSF and holding a dual AIFM and UCITS license as well as a MiFID authorization. Its business has been licensed since 1971 and was carved out and wholly acquired (100%) by BlackFin in 2025; FundSight has since been an independent company, with no operational or capital ties to Lemanik. It has a center of excellence in Porto, a branch in Paris, and representative offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. The Group is also established in New York and Atlanta. FundSight today supports more than 120 institutional clients and manages more than €40 billion in assets under management. For more information: www.fundsight.com.

How to apply

If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to develop your career in a young, dynamic and international environment, please send your cover letter and detailed CV in English to recruitment@fundsight.com (reference: “Risk Officer – UCITS”).

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Before the employment agreement is signed, a copy of an official criminal record certificate (Bulletin No. 3), issued within the previous two months, must be provided for review.

Description

Job Summary

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) delivers millions of packages to customers every day across Amazon's Last Mile network. Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) operates a complex, dynamic Surface Transportation (ST) business. Supporting AMZL and ATS, the Global Fleet and Products (GFP) organization manages Fleet technology, capacity, vehicle in-life services programs, vendor management, planning and execution, and establishes vehicle requirements to move goods between Amazon Operations locations and deliver parcels to customers' doorsteps.

EU Fleet Finance is a specialized team of 8 finance professionals partnering with GFP in EU to drive strategic investment decisions and optimize fleet performance across 10 European countries. Finance is providing planning, analysis, and cost controllership for the middle and last mile fleet of tractors, trailers and delivery vehicles. Together with operations leaders and AMZL, ATS and DSP Finance organizations we optimize fleet costs, define vehicle economics, and shape Amazon's delivery model. Our work directly influences strategic decisions on preferred vehicle types, alternative mobility solutions, and partner remuneration models. We are continuously expanding this business partnership to international GFP activities.

The team is seeking a Finance Manager to connect team activities across sourcing, project and program activities, for both middle and last mile, coordinating and consolidating quantitative and qualitative information when it comes to planning and reporting. This role requires an experienced finance professional who will independently assess and handle priorities in an increasingly complex environment, ensuring appropriate stakeholder management.

Given our team's size and scope, you'll engage with numerous stakeholders across GFP operations teams and Finance organizations, providing subject matter expertise to senior leaders. You'll define, track and help to improve metrics measuring vehicle operating costs, cost per package, route economics, and kilometer efficiency. The role combines European-wide perspective with country-level insights, evolving with fleet lifecycle management, new vehicle acquisitions, and innovative sourcing models.

Key job responsibilities

• Own, execute and develop financial reporting and planning processes for Middle and Last Mile Fleet cost: (1) Lead execution of Weekly Business Reviews, Month-End-Close, Monthly Financial Reviews, and planning cycles with limited oversight; (2) ensure accuracy through proactive auditing and key controllership activities CapEx and OpEx; (3) Build financial models addressing complex fleet cost questions; convert data into actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership;
• Stakeholder Management: (1) ensure accurate and concise reporting on vehicle financials, relevant for multiple Finance teams; (2) communicate financial performance expectations and results to L8 operations stakeholders; (3) influence tactical and strategic fleet decisions to meet financial commitments;
• Metrics Development: (1) Develop and track fleet economics metrics including cost per package, route, load and kilometer; (2) analyze vehicle operating costs across 10 European countries
• Process Improvement: (1) Identify automation opportunities, reduce defects, and implement solutions that scale across the European fleet finance function; (2) support establishing WW process standards within WW Fleet Finance.

Basic Qualifications

- A degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another relevant field
- Relevant experience in a finance role including partnering with a variety of stakeholders across the business
- Relevant experience working with Excel and large-scale data mining and reporting tools such as Python, SQL or Tableau
- Relevant experience in financial modelling

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced or master's degree in finance, economics or mathematics, such as a CA, CMA, CWA or MBA
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organisation
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influence decisions

title: Launch MBA Program (m/f)
description:
Launch MBA Program
Job ID: 10552798 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Launch - Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. While we will consider location preferences if possible, we ask you to be as location-agnostic as possible since you may receive an offer from any of these corporate locations. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

description:

locations: Luxembourg

Arendt Regulatory & Consulting (ARC) is Arendt's dedicated regulatory consulting arm composed of diverse and experienced professionals with a strong background in regulatory and business consultancy.

Our 120 experts offer regulatory consulting and advisory services and assistance to an international and sophisticated client base across multiple industries. This includes a range of services from the classic regulatory consulting, working with funds, their asset managers and asset servicers on the practical implementation of rules and regulations, to topics such as risk management, fund distribution, fund governance, and compliance of Luxembourg regulated entities.

ARC responds to the growing needs of clients with a practical yet legally effective approach to regulatory change management and other regulatory matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:

Cross-boarder Distribution, Advisor

Being involved in fund registration and post-registration services in jurisdictions across Europe, Asia and Latin America;
Guaranteeing the follow-up of regulatory reportings and publications;
Supporting your manager by preparing the notification files and communications to the various regulators and by following up the various registration maintenance obligations.


Your profile:

You hold a two-three year diploma ideally in Business Administration, Economics or Law;
You just graduated or have a minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar position or a relevant experience in the Luxembourg fund industry;
You have developed strong knowledge in investment fund regulations;
You are fluent in both written and oral in German and English. French will be considered as an advantage;
You are dedicated to work in a fast growing environment;
You are seen as a proactive person with good communication skills;
You are well organised and rigorous.
‎

Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.

Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.

title: Vi søger en erfaren og kommercielt stærk Country Manager til at drive vækst, opbygge strategiske relationer.
description:
Country Manager – Nordic iGaming Market

Lokation: Sliema, Malta Løn: €50.000–90.000 årligt (brutto)

Vi søger en erfaren og kommercielt stærk Country Manager til at drive vækst, opbygge strategiske relationer og udvide vores tilstedeværelse på det nordiske iGaming‑marked. Rollen er målrettet en profil med solid brancheerfaring, stærkt netværk og dokumenteret evne til at skabe nye forretningsmuligheder. Du får ansvar for at udvikle regionen, åbne nye partnerskaber og levere kommercielle resultater i et internationalt, højt tempo miljø.

Om rollen

Som Country Manager får du det fulde kommercielle ansvar for den nordiske region. Du arbejder udpræget “hunter‑style” med fokus på new business development, strategiske partnerskaber og skalering af markedspositionen. Rollen kræver en netværksstærk profil, der kan åbne døre hurtigt, opbygge relationer på C‑level og lukke aftaler selvstændigt.

Du vil identificere nye muligheder, drive hele B2B‑salgscyklussen, repræsentere virksomheden på tværs af branchen og sikre, at vores løsninger er stærkt positioneret i markedet.

Hvorfor arbejde her – og hvad betyder det for din karriere?

At arbejde i denne organisation giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i et af verdens mest avancerede og hurtigt voksende iGaming‑miljøer. Virksomheden leverer software, platforme og live‑casino løsninger i topklasse og opererer globalt med tusindvis af specialister på tværs af flere internationale hubs.

Du bliver en del af en kultur, hvor ejerskab, professionalisme og kommerciel kvalitet er centrale værdier. Det betyder, at du får frihed til at drive din region, forme strategier og opbygge partnerskaber på højt niveau — samtidig med at du har stærke interne ressourcer inden for produkt, marketing og teknologi.

Karrieremæssigt giver rollen dig:

  • adgang til globale projekter og internationale stakeholders

  • mulighed for at arbejde med markedsledende iGaming‑produkter

  • et miljø, hvor kommercielle profiler kan vokse hurtigt og få synlig impact

  • stærk eksponering i hele branchen gennem events, konferencer og C‑level netværk

  • en platform, hvor dine resultater direkte påvirker regionens vækst og virksomhedens position

Kort sagt: Du får en mulighed for at accelerere din karriere, udvide dit netværk og arbejde i et internationalt setup, hvor innovation, kvalitet og kommerciel eksekvering er i centrum.

Dine ansvarsområder

  • Identificere og udvikle nye forretningsmuligheder gennem research, netværk og strategisk outreach

  • Drive hele salgsprocessen fra første kontakt til lukket aftale

  • Opbygge og vedligeholde en stærk, aktiv pipeline

  • Forstå kundebehov og levere en konsulentbaseret, løsningsorienteret salgsstrategi

  • Udvikle langvarige relationer med kunder og nøgleinteressenter

  • Agere produktspecialist og præsentere både eksisterende og kommende løsninger

  • Samarbejde med interne teams for at konvertere leads til partnerskaber

  • Udarbejde kommercielle tilbud og præsentationer

  • Rapportere pipeline‑status og salgsprogression

  • Repræsentere virksomheden på messer, konferencer og brancheevents

  • Afholde produktdemonstrationer online og fysisk

  • Samarbejde med Product og Marketing for at understøtte initiativer, der driver ny forretning

Krav til dig

  • Flydende svensk eller dansk samt stærke engelskkundskaber

  • Et eksisterende C‑level netværk i gaming/gambling‑branchen

  • Dokumenteret erfaring fra det nordiske iGaming‑marked (B2B eller kommerciel B2C)

  • Indgående kendskab til casino, slots og live casino produkter

  • Erfaring med udvikling og eksekvering af regionale eller globale salgsstrategier

  • God forståelse for marketingprincipper

  • Evne til at arbejde i et hurtigt, komplekst og foranderligt miljø

  • Stærke organisatoriske evner og evne til at håndtere flere prioriteter

  • Selvstændig, proaktiv og motiveret med stærk kommerciel drivkraft

  • Evne til at påvirke, inspirere og opbygge langvarige relationer

  • Hands‑on tilgang og stærk sense of ownership

  • Datadrevet mindset og fokus på resultater

Benefits

  • Omfattende onboarding og træning efter høje branchestandarder

  • Støttende, inkluderende og samarbejdsorienteret virksomhedskultur

  • Fremragende karrieremuligheder i en hurtigt voksende international organisation

  • Adgang til løbende læring og udvikling via dedikeret læringsplatform

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement

Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

Word jij de SHEQ Adviseur die veiligheid, structuur en daadkracht brengt in complexe hijs- en transportprojecten?

Je bent communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
Je bent computer vaardig en bent in staat om open gesprekken te voeren;
Je bent beschikbaar van maandag tot en met vrijdag voor minimaal 24 uur per week tussen 8:30 en 17:00 uur.

Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken en aantrekkelijke bonussen.

Na een inwerktraject van 2 keer 3 dagen met de nodige coaching en begeleiding, kun jij zelfstandig aan de slag. Jij staat klanten zo goed mogelijk te woord en zorgt ervoor dat zij een ultieme klantervaring hebben.

Jij wil de beste zijn in je werk en woont hiervoor trainingen en presentaties bij. Jij staat iedere klant te woord en geeft hen die unieke klantbeleving, pas dan ben jij tevreden.

Bij deze functie is het mogelijk om thuis te werken en krijg je het benodigde apparatuur in bruikleen.

Je voert klantgerichte en op overtuigende wijze in-bound gesprekken met bestaande klanten;
Je beantwoord vragen van klanten, welke onder andere gaan over betalingen, contracten of nota's, welke je daarna administratief verwerkt;
Je past de administratie aan waar nodig, denk aan adresgegevens, verhuizing en opzegging.

Job Description
As a nurse level 4 you are, together with your colleagues, responsible for providing support with personal care and nursing to clients in the home situation with the aim of maintaining or improving self-reliance so that the client can continue to live independently for as long as possible.
It is up to you to support the clients with basic personal care, counseling in the psychosocial field and in the field of meaning. Also supporting the client and family caregiver in maintaining control over their own lives (self-management) and providing information, advice and instruction to promote prevention are part of your duties.
You are able to independently perform the caring and accompanying activities in the home/living situation of the client. You are also able to actively contribute to the preservation or improvement of the health and well-being of the client by timely identifying (potential) health problems and taking action in response. Writing reports in the care file is of course also part of your job.
You are empathetic and able to provide a listening ear to the client and family/caregivers without loss of professionalism.

Offer Description
We have a postdoc position open for the period of 3 years (0.8 FTE) within the PREDWEI 2 project. The aim of the project is to improve understanding of the spatial dynamics and shifting interactions among different predator species-both terrestrial and aerial-affecting ground-breeding birds (meadow, arable, and coastal species). The project will produce recommendations for effective management and policy regarding the various predator species, with the aim of increasing chick survival. The research will make an important contribution to knowledge on effective management for the conservation of ground-breeding birds and will identify the remaining knowledge gaps after completion of the study.
Previous PREDWEI studies have provided substantial insight into the important role of various terrestrial predator species and their interactions in relation to ground-breeding birds. At the same time, these studies have revealed important knowledge gaps that are highly relevant for improving the effectiveness of policy and management aimed at protecting ground-breeding birds. This applies to the main landscape types in which these birds occur: meadow, arable, and coastal habitats, each with its own community of terrestrial and aerial predators (mammals and birds of prey).

As an Electrical BIM Modeler, you will work on the design and development of high-voltage substations in the Netherlands. You will translate electrical engineering input into accurate 3D models and technical drawings, working closely with Primary and Secondary Engineers, Civil Engineers and other BIM specialists. You will work on both new substations and extensions or modifications of existing installations. What will you do? You will be responsible for developing and maintaining BIM models for electrical substation projects. Your work will include: Creating and updating 3D BIM models for high-voltage substations; Modelling electrical equipment and substation components in Autodesk Revit; Working with equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, busbars, cable routes and supporting structures; Producing layouts, sections, details and technical drawings from the 3D model; Adding and maintaining technical information and object data within the BIM environment; Coordinating the electrical model with Civil, Structural and other engineering disciplines; Identifying clashes and design inconsistencies; Processing design changes throughout different project phases; Supporting Primary and Secondary Engineers with model-based engineering; Contributing to BIM standards, libraries and modelling workflows; Checking models and drawings for quality, completeness and constructability. BIM Modeler, BIM Coordinator or Electrical Engineering; Bicycle leasing and fitness schemes; International and multidisciplinary engineering projects; A professional but informal working environment. Why move from Spain to the Netherlands? The Netherlands is investing heavily in the expansion and reinforcement of its electricity grid. This creates long-term engineering opportunities in substations and high-voltage infrastructure. For an experienced electrical BIM professional, this role offers the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in a sector with a substantial long-term project pipeline. title: Werkplaatsmedewerker Textiel
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Zuyd Hogeschool een Werkplaatsmedewerker Textiel

Actief bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van de nieuwe generatie makers en denkers?
Heb je aantoonbare expertise in weven, breien, tuften en aanverwante technieken en wil je jouw vakmanschap, kennis en enthousiasme graag overbrengen op een nieuwe generatie makers? Krijg je energie van het begeleiden van studenten, het delen van je kennis en het stimuleren van hun ambachtelijke én artistieke ontwikkeling? Dan is dit een mooie kans om jouw ervaring, passie en vakmanschap in te zetten binnen een inspirerende leeromgeving.

Over de functie
Als werkplaatsmedewerker Textiel begeleid je studenten bij de realisatie van twee- en driedimensionale ontwerpen in textiel. Je adviseert over materiaalkeuze, maakbaarheid en productieprocessen en geeft instructies in de volgende technieken:

• Weven
Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met verschillende weeftechnieken en het werken op handmatige en/of (semi-)elektronische weefgetouwen. Je kunt studenten begeleiden bij het opzetten van een weefsel, het kiezen en combineren van garens, bindingen en structuren en het vertalen van een ontwerp naar een technisch uitvoerbaar weefsel.
• Breien
Je hebt ervaring met handmatig en machinaal breien en kent verschillende breistructuren en toepassingen. Je kunt breimachines instellen en bedienen en studenten begeleiden bij het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van ontwerpen in breiwerk. Ervaring met computergestuurde breimachines en bijbehorende software is een pré.
• Tuften
Je hebt ervaring met handmatig en/of machinaal tuften en kunt studenten begeleiden bij het volledige maakproces: van ontwerp en materiaalkeuze tot het opspannen, tuften, verlijmen en afwerken van het werk.
• Overige textieltechnieken
Je hebt kennis van vezels, garens en kunt studenten begeleiden bij het verwerken van garen. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met naaitechnieken, patroonontwikkeling en coupe waarin je studenten kan begeleiden.
• Werkplaatsbeheer
Je hebt ervaring met of affiniteit voor het beheren van een textielwerkplaats, waaronder machineonderhoud, het oplossen van eenvoudige storingen, voorraadbeheer en het veilig opslaan en gebruiken van materialen en apparatuur. Je draagt bij aan een veilige, efficiënte en inspirerende werkplaatsomgeving. Tijdens vrije werkplaatsmomenten begeleid je studenten bij maakprocessen en stimuleer je hen om zelfstandig, veilig en onderzoekend te werken.

Wat wij vragen
• Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring en/of affiniteit met alle bovengenoemde technieken en kunt dit laten zien in je portfolio.
• Je hebt een sterke technische achtergrond en kunt complexe processen duidelijk uitleggen.
• Ervaring met kennisoverdracht en onderwijs is een pluspunt.
• Ervaring binnen de kunsten of creatieve sector is een pré.

title: Expeditie Daelzicht,  jouw kans om het roer om te gooien!
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Daelzicht een medewerker begeleiding.

Oké, je hebt een aardige baan. Maar je mist het gevoel écht van waarde te zijn voor een ander. Niet gek, want je bent zorgzaam, flexibel en een echte teamspeler. Maar je hebt een heel andere opleiding gedaan en geen beroepsmatige ervaring op het gebied van zorg. Je baan opzeggen en terug naar de schoolbanken is voor jou geen optie. Dan hebben wij de gouden kans voor jou: Expeditie Daelzicht! Je krijgt meteen een contract en je volgt een passende (verkorte) opleidingsroute.

Zo ziet jouw baan eruit

Bij Expeditie Daelzicht ga je vanaf dag 1 aan de slag in de functie van Medewerker begeleiding. Jouw eigen buddy op locatie begeleidt jou hierbij. Afhankelijk van de mate van zelfstandigheid van de bewoner en de locatie begeleid jij bewoners in hun thuissituatie. Dit kan variëren van begeleiden en coachen (‘zorgen dat’ in plaats van ‘zorgen voor’) tot ondersteunen bij algemene dagelijkse handelingen zoals douchen en naar de wc gaan. In sommige groepen betekent dit dat je de volledige lichamelijk verzorging doet. Het is belangrijk dat je altijd rust uitstraalt en duidelijk en betrouwbaar bent. Je kunt in dit werk zéker je creativiteit kwijt: je bent altijd op zoek naar de mogelijkheden van de bewoners. Je gaat werken én leren. Vanaf de start van het traject volg je boeiende trainingen en opleidingsmodules.

Waar ga je werken? We hebben vooral instroomkansen in Midden-Limburg en Noord-Limburg. Om te bepalen waar jij het beste op je plek bent, volgen we bij Expeditie Daelzicht een heldere route:

  • We maken kennis met elkaar in een persoonlijk gesprek. Hebben we een ‘klik’? Dan nemen we de volgende stap.
  • De vervolgstap is een meeloopervaring en het maken van een testprogramma. Geen zorgen ! Deze test gaat niet over “goed of fout’, ‘voldoende of onvoldoende’. Het resultaat gaat ons helpen om jou, als we doorgaan met elkaar, zo goed mogelijk te ondersteunen in je leerproces. Na het meelopen en de test wegen we allebei weer af of we verder gaan op onze route.
  • Bij voortzetting ga je vervolgens in gesprek met een HR collega van Leren & Ontwikkelen. Dit in verband met het leer- en ontwikkeltraject verbonden aan Expeditie Daelzicht.
  • Op basis van alle inzichten zoeken we dan een match met een locatie die bij jou past en waar een vacature is voor een Expeditie kandidaat. Daar ga je dan in gesprek met de betreffende manager Zorg en hopen aansluitend de stap naar een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek te gaan zetten.

Jij bent

  • iemand die door te ondersteunen, zorgen en verzorgen van waarde wil zijn voor een ander.
  • bereid om volgens een onregelmatig dienstenpatroon te werken en waar nodig ook lichamelijk verzorgende taken op je te nemen.
  • in het bezit van een diploma van een beroepsopleiding op minimaal mbo 3-niveau met aanvullend enige jaren werkervaring.
  • iemand die geen zin heeft om weer jarenlang de schoolbanken in te gaan maar wel betekenisvol werken wil combineren met leren en ontwikkelen.
  • bovenal enthousiast om te gaan voor je kans om deze betekenisvolle loopbaanstap te zetten. Ongeveer 40 collega’s zijn je al voorgegaan!
