title: Head of Editorial
description:
Head of Editorial

About TOTEME

TOTEME is a fashion house rooted in Swedish sensibilities, modern aspirations, and the notion of style.

With an appreciation for how pieces are worn in practice, we create emblematic designs with an emphasis on materiality and shape. Archetype pieces are realized in authentic materials, rich textures and graphic silhouettes. Representing a direct and decisive way of dressing, the collections are contextualized in curated edits, visuals, and spaces.

TOTEME was founded in 2014 by Elin Kling and Karl Lindman. From the atelier in Stockholm, we create women’s and men’s collections spanning ready-to-wear, shoes, bags, accessories, and jewelry.

The Role

TOTEME is looking for a Head of Editorial to join our team in Stockholm on a full-timebasis. In this role, you will define and lead TOTEME’s global editorial direction, shaping the brand’s voice and narratives across women’s and men’s collections, markets and customer touchpoints. You will report to the Chief Marketing Officer and work directly with the Creative, Brand and Communications Teams.

Responsibilities

    Define and evolve TOTEME’s global editorial direction, tone of voice and messaging principles.
    Develop seasonal narratives, collection briefs and notes, and oversee the seasonal editorial calendar.
    Lead editorial concepts and messaging for campaigns, launches, collaborations, events and key brand initiatives.
    Own editorial storytelling and copy for seasonal newsletters and organic Instagram, and develop new storytelling formats.
    Write and shape brand statements, press releases, corporate messaging and communications for senior leadership.
    Lead naming for key products and develop product stories that connect to wider seasonal and brand narratives.
    Establish messaging frameworks that guide consistent communication across teams, regional markets and retail education.
    Provide editorial direction to the Lead Copywriter, setting priorities and workflows and reviewing key communications.
    Participate in and contribute to TOTEME’s social and environmental sustainability strategy.

Your Profile

    Extensive experience in editorial leadership, copywriting or brand communications within fashion, luxury or a similarly brand-led environment.
    Proven ability to develop distinctive brand narratives, campaign concepts and messaging frameworks across channels and markets.
    A sophisticated understanding of fashion, design, culture and luxury positioning.
    Experience guiding writers and collaborating with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
    Fluent in spoken and written English, with exceptional writing and editing skills.

About You

    A TOTEME ambassador who shares our culture and values.
    Strong creative judgment and a considered approach to storytelling.
    A strategic mindset that connects brand expression with business priorities.
    Highly organized, balancing long-term editorial direction with ongoing business needs.
    A confident, collaborative communicator who provides clear direction and builds alignment across teams.

This is a full-time  position based at TOTEME’s Stockholm Office, starting in January 2027.

TOTEME has teams in Stockholm, London, New York, and Shanghai, as well as retail spaces across Europe, North America, and Asia.

TOTEME has an internal career development and title framework and the job title used in the recruitment ad may differ from the title used internally at TOTEME.

Candidates progress through application, screening, interviews or case assessments, followed by final pre-employment checks and a formal offer before joining our team. We anonymize names and personal details in applications during the screening stage to support fair and skills-based hiring.

By applying to this position, I agree with TOTEME’s privacy policy and to be contacted about future job opportunities for up to two years from the submission date. Find out more about our privacy policy here.

title: Senior research engineer to Robotics and AI
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics & AI Group at Luleå University of Technology is seeking a motivated Senior Research Engineer with a focus on software and hardware development for autonomous robots.





The Robotics & AI Group is involved in numerous field-oriented projects, requiring a versatile and proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment.





Project description



You will join an excellent team and collaborate with a diverse group of people working in the field of Robotics and AI.





Duties

    Translating MATLAB code to Python/C++.
    Setting up simulation environments for different use cases.
    Develop and optimize software for robotic systems using Python and C++.
    Work with ROS (Robot Operating System) for robot control, navigation, and perception.
    Integrate hardware and software components for real-time robotic applications and ROS.
    Providing support during experiments both in the lab and on the field.
    Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of engineers to improve system performance.
    Perform soldering and maintenance of robots.
    Help manage electrical parts inventory and laboratory equipment.
    Help maintain and upgrade laboratory equipment.

Qualifications



For senior research engineers a bachelor’s degree in robotics, computer science, automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or another relevant engineering field is required.

    Holds a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Robotics/Electrical/Software or equivalent educational background in relevant subjects.

    Proficiency in Python and C++ for robotic applications.
    Strong experience with ROS (ROS1 or ROS2).
    Good knowledge of MATLAB for simulation and analysis.
    Familiarity with robotic perception, control, and kinematics.
    Experience with Linux environments and version control (Git).
    Hands-on experience with building robots and low voltage electrical systems.
    Willingness to travel and adapt quickly to new challenges.
    Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Additional qualifications (preferable)

    B driving license (EU)
    Drone pilot permit (EU)
    Knowledge of AI/ML applications in robotics.
    Familiarity with hardware interfaces, sensors, and actuators.

Further information



Fulltime time position for 12 months, with a possibility for extension. Placement: Luleå. Starting: as soon as possible or upon agreement.

title: ADAS System Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience.

We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris Consulting: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As every role is different, we adapt the process accordingly, always focusing on the best possible candidate experience. We look forward to meeting you!

Job description

Join Amaris Consulting as an consultant for one of our clients, specialized in ADAS System Engineer and contribute to high-impact automotive projects within the Engineering scope. You will support the design and specification of software requirements for driver information systems, with a focus on ADAS Surround View features and seamless integration across existing and future vehicle models.

Your missions

    Design and specify software requirements for in-house development teams.
    Develop interfaces and define signals within driver information systems.
    Contribute to the integration of ADAS Surround View features in the Driver Information module.
    Ensure compatibility with existing and future vehicle models.
    Collaborate with suppliers to align technical requirements and delivery expectations.
    Define requirements with a strong focus on testability and quality assurance.
    Prepare and review test reports and DVM documentation.
    Support project delivery in complex environments with short ramp-up periods.

Your profile

    Experience in system design within the automotive industry, ideally on ADAS-related projects.
    Experience with ADAS technology, especially Surround View or driver information systems.
    Experience with CANoe for system analysis, validation, or testing activities.
    Experience with Matlab, Simulink, and Stateflow.
    Experience in writing test reports and DVM documentation.
    Knowledge of software requirements specification and interface definition.
    Valid European driver’s license B.
    English fluent.
    Strong analytical mindset and ability to solve complex technical issues.
    Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, suppliers, and project stakeholders.

What we offer

    An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities.
    An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities.
    A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules.
    A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events, including afterworks and team buildings.
    At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.
    Invest in your skills with a yearly training budget.
    Join innovation labs and AI initiatives.
    Work on high-impact projects in IT, Life Sciences, Engineering, and more.

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

RaySearch is expanding its machine learning capabilities and is looking for a Machine Learning Platform Engineer to join our headquarters in Stockholm. This is an office-first role.

You will help build our model development platform: the systems that take clinical data through curation, training and validation to deployed models. Our deep learning models are used in RayStation, our treatment planning system, at cancer clinics worldwide. The platform you build is how the next generation of these models gets made.

This is not primarily a model development role. Your focus is the platform, data and infrastructure that let ML engineers develop, validate and deploy models reliably.

About the job

You will join RaySearch's Machine Learning department and help build a platform that covers the full model lifecycle, from clinical data coming in to validated models going out.

The work spans:

    Data curation and management: ingesting, organizing and validating large clinical datasets and medical images, with ETL, databases and storage that keep track of where data came from and how it was used.
    Model training: reproducible training pipelines orchestrated with Flyte, for dose prediction, segmentation, detection, classification and image registration, with monitoring of training runs.
    Validation: automated evaluation and reporting that connects data, method, code and results, including web-based tools for reviewing images, contours, radiotherapy plans and validation outcomes.
    Deployment and ML integration: getting models into production and integrated into our software products, including inference optimization.
    Operations: monitoring training and evaluation runs, keeping services and databases up to date, and troubleshooting when things go wrong.
    The platform is used by multiple teams and projects, so good design matters: well-designed APIs, solid documentation and reliable services. You will own services from design to operation and work closely with ML engineers, software developers, infrastructure teams, medical physicists and product teams.

Your profile

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys building systems that help others do their best work. You are pragmatic: you know when a simple solution is enough and when the problem needs a more scalable architecture. You care about reliability, automation and developer experience. You like building platforms that are robust and well-designed enough to serve many different users.

You don't need to spend your days training neural networks. You do understand how ML development differs from traditional software engineering, and you find problems like reproducibility, data lineage, model versioning, large datasets and GPU workloads interesting.

Requirements

    M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning or equivalent experience, and at least 5 years of professional software engineering.
    Strong Python skills and experience designing backend services and APIs.
    Solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling, such as PostgreSQL.
    Experience with containers, for example Docker, and with designing, running and troubleshooting production services.
    Good engineering practices: automated testing, code review, CI/CD and observability.
    Experience contributing to architecture decisions in large, shared codebases.
    Excellent spoken and written English.

Meriting

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

    ML platforms and MLOps tooling, such as MLflow and experiment tracking.
    PyTorch, and model deployment or inference optimization, such as TensorRT.
    Workflow orchestration and ETL. We use Flyte, but experience with Airflow, Prefect, Dagster or similar is just as relevant.
    Kubernetes, cloud platforms and infrastructure as code.
    Designing platforms and APIs used by many teams or users, including access control and security.
    Operating production services with high reliability requirements.
    Web application development.
    Medical imaging (DICOM, RT structures), healthcare technology or other regulated, safety-critical environments.

Our Culture 

At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide. 

Our Offer 

We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package. 

Application 

Please apply for the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

title: PMO Lead - AI Transformation (Value Governance)
description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups, and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future, and we want you to be part of it.

We are now scaling the use of AI across Husqvarna Group and are looking for an PMO Lead to help turn AI initiatives into measurable business value.

You will join our AI Hub, our AI Center of Excellence, working at the intersection of business and technology to accelerate the leverage and value of AI.

About the role:

In this role, you will enable the effective operation and continued development of our AI Hub. You will provide structure, coordination, governance, and transparent reporting across the Hub, helping ensure that priorities, decisions and AI initiatives are translated into measurable business value.

Acting as a central coordination point, you will connect the AI Hub with our business divisions, Group Functions, GIS/IT, Product Owners, Transformation Leads and governance bodies. The role combines hands-on program management with the development of scalable processes, tools and ways of working.  You will build visibility into how AI investments impact business outcomes, supporting leaders in making informed decisions on priorities, investments, and long-term direction.

Your main responsibilities include:

    Maintain the integrated AI Hub roadmap, coordinating milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points and progress against agreed priorities.
    Design governance structure, set success measures, and establish execution roadmap before launch.
    Own and continuously develop the AI Hub Value Realization Framework, establishing consistent principles and tools for identifying, tracking and reporting business value.
    Develop executive-level narratives and board-ready materials that translate complex analysis into decision-forcing stories on strategic priorities.
    Own the governance calendar and ensure key forums are supported by clear agendas, decision-relevant information, documented outcomes and consistent follow-up.
    Maintain and evolve a consolidated view of the AI portfolio, partnering closely with Product Owners and GIS/IT to synthesize delivery information, risks, dependencies and outcomes into clear reporting and actionable insights for different stakeholders.
    Strengthen direction and collaboration across business divisions, Group Functions and GIS/IT by clarifying responsibilities, working routines and cross-functional dependencies.
    Design and improve practical processes, templates and working methods that support planning, prioritization, delivery tracking and benefits realization.
    Partner with Finance and Product Strategy to develop business cases for key initiatives, connecting strategic direction to capital allocation.
    Own the Increment Preparation process by defining roles, timelines and deliverables, ensuring timely planning and stakeholder communication, and continuously improving ways of working.

You will report to our VP of AI Value Acceleration.

About you:

You’re a structured, proactive and pragmatic program management professional who enjoys bringing clarity to complex, cross-functional environments. You combine strong attention to detail with the ability to see the bigger picture, and you are comfortable coordinating multiple initiatives, creating alignment and communicating with senior stakeholders.

You know how to establish effective governance without creating unnecessary administration. You follow through on commitments and can develop processes and frameworks that are rigorous, practical, and easy for others to use.

Your skills and background:

    A university degree in engineering, business, economics, or another relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.
    A background in management consulting, corporate strategy, portfolio management, or transformation and program leadership in complex, cross-functional environments, or equivalent experience in a corporate setting.
    Demonstrated experience establishing governance, planning, reporting, and tracking business value and outcomes across a portfolio of initiatives.
    Experience operating at senior management level, with the credibility and confidence to engage effectively with executive stakeholders and influence strategic discussions.
    Structural and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand the bigger picture, synthesize complex information, and identify connections across teams, initiatives and priorities.
    Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams without direct authority; comfort with ambiguity.
    Strong facilitation, presentation and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages and recommendations to different audiences.
    Capacity to design processes and frameworks that balance consistency, rigor and ease of use.
    Advanced user of Excel and PowerPoint, capable of building financial models, scenario analyses, and strategic presentations at board level.
    Experience with digital transformation, AI, analytics or technology-enabled business change is an advantage.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Location

The preferred location for this position is Stockholm, Sweden, although the role can also be based at our other main sites in Huskvarna or Jonsered.

Your Application:

Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we find the right person. For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Johan Odelfelt at johan.odelfelt@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application, we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice.

title: IT Service Coordinator - Sales & Marketing
description:
Keep business-critical applications running smoothly by connecting users, support teams, technical specialists and external vendors. As our IT Coordinator at Salesforce Mining, you coordinate operational support, drive issue towards resolution and help maintain reliable, high-quality services.  



This is a great opportunity to build your career within the segment while gaining broad operational experience:

    Coordinating issues that span multiple teams and systems.
    Work with stakeholders across the business, IT and external service providers.  
    Contribute to continuous improvements in service quality and user experience.  



About your job

You coordinate day-to-day operational support of business applications and the delivery of application management services. By monitoring support performance, aligning activities across teams and maintaining clear stakeholder communication, you help safeguard application availability, service quality and user satisfaction.  



Job responsibilities

    Coordinate incidents, service requests and problems involving multiple teams, systems and service dependencies.  
    Oversee ServiceNow queues, application health, support trends and operational risks, following tickets through resolution.
    Connect business users, application support teams, technical specialists and external vendors, including gathering information and managing escalations.  
    Coordinating major incidents, root cause analyses and corrective actions that improve service stability.  
    Track service performance against agreed service levels and operational objectives, providing reports and relevant data.
    Maintain support documentation and support the transition of new capabilities into application management, including readiness and hypercare activities.  



Location

This position is in Sandviken.

Your profile

You have a relevant university-level education and a couple of years of experience in IT service coordination, application support or a related field. A sound understanding of service management helps you connect stakeholder needs with practical action and keep work moving across several teams.  



Your background includes

    A Bachelor of Science degree or another relevant university-level, data related program.  
    Experience coordinating operational support, incidents, service requests or problems.
    An understanding of how ITIL incidents, problems, change and knowledge processes work together.
    Good written and spoken English.
    It’s a plus if you have an ITIL certificate.  



Clear communication and collaboration come naturally to you. You facilitate discussions, create structure and take ownership of progress from initial request to resolution. With sound business judgement, you understand stakeholder needs, notice emerging trends and act proactively.  

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

title: Experienced Consultant | People Consulting | Stockholm
description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of people, change and business transformation? EY People Consulting is growing and looking for experienced consultants with a passion for change management who can help organizations translate transformation ambitions into meaningful and sustainable change.

In Sweden, our team of around 60 consultants across Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö is part of a strong Nordic and global network, working to create real impact for our clients and their people.



The opportunity



Together with our clients, we drive transformation from ambition to execution, creating positive experiences of change. We help organizations understand, prepare for and navigate the people-related impact of transformation through structured change management, stakeholder engagement, communication, learning and adoption.

As technology and AI reshape organizations, we believe people remain at the core of successful transformation. People Consulting helps clients set a clear strategic direction and design scalable, AI‑enabled ways of working that create long‑term value at the intersection of people, technology and business.





Your key responsibilities



As an experienced consultant, you work in teams with EY colleagues and directly with clients in large‑scale transformation initiatives - from analysis and design to implementation and adoption.

You are encouraged to identify new business opportunities, build relationships, and help strengthen our market presence as People Consulting continues to grow.





To succeed in this role, you need to:



    Be passionate about change management, organizational transformation and the human side of transformation
    Lead and deliver workstreams within People Consulting engagements, including designing and facilitating workshops with senior client stakeholders
    Translate complex transformation challenges into clear, actionable deliverables and solve complex problems using creative, strategic, and analytical methods and tools
    Communicate complex change in a clear, engaging and audience-focused way
    Have a genuine interest in AI and a working understanding of how it is reshaping organizations, work and value creation
    Be a curious, continuous learner who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is energized by change and new technology
    Contribute to proposal development and capability building within People Consulting
    Build strong, trust-based relationships with clients and colleagues, and coach and support junior consultants



Skills and attributes for success  



You combine a structured and analytical approach with strong communication and interpersonal skills. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, engaging stakeholders at different levels and adapting your approach as transformation needs evolve. You understand that successful change requires both a clear direction and practical support that helps people adopt new behaviors, processes and ways of working.





Qualifications



    Relevant university degree (e.g., business, industrial engineering, strategic HR, economics, behavioral sciences)
    4–6+ years of relevant work experience after graduation
    Practical experience in change management, organizational transformation or another closely related area
    Experience taking ownership of deliverables and working independently in client engagements
    Experience translating concepts into implemented solutions and realized impact
    Solid understanding of AI and digitalization from a business and transformation perspective
    Strong analytical, communicative and relationship building skills
    Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)
    Advanced skills in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
    



Meriting qualifications



    Background in management consulting
    Experience with AI and datadriven transformations
    Advanced proficiency in Swedish, spoken and written
    



We are looking for someone who shares EY’s values



At EY, you work on high impact assignments with leading organizations, in an inclusive and trusted culture that offers continuous development, early responsibility, and flexible ways of working. Read more about what EY can offer you at ey.com/careers.  





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.  



Please submit your application no later than 8thth of November 2026. Selection and interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis. We will review applications after the summer period starting from late August 2026 and plan to start interviewing in September, with interviews conducted on a rolling basis thereafter.



Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have questions about the role, please contact Jesper Johansson at Jesper.Johansson1@se.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Adrian Lyng at Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Produktionstekniker
description:
Din nya utmaning

Vår produktion växer och som en del av vår fortsatta expansion bygger vi nu upp ett nytt team på en ny produktionssite vid vårt huvudkontor i Helsingborg. Som Produktionstekniker blir du en del av vår växande produktionsverksamhet och får möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av både våra arbetssätt, team och produktion framåt.

Du kommer främst att arbeta med montering av våra högteknologiska produkter i ett varierat arbete där kvalitet står i fokus. Här får du möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens, ta ansvar och vara med på vår fortsatta tillväxtresa.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

    

Montering av både mekaniska och elektroniska delar i MilDefs produkter.

    

Utföra mindre omfattande lödning av elektroniska komponenter och ledningar.

    

Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar för att öka effektiviteten och kvaliteten i produktionsmiljön.

Det här bidrar du med

    

Har en teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.

    

Erfarenhet inom elektronikmontering från en relevant produktionsmiljö.

    

God datavana.

    

Du är ordningsam, strukturerad, noggrann och har ett stort tekniskt intresse.

    

Social kompetens och en lagspelare som bidrar till ett effektivt samarbete.

    

Förmåga att läsa tekniska arbetsinstruktioner, manualer och enkla ritningar.

    

Uttrycker dig med mycket god förmåga på både svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Lär känna oss

På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ, som wellness-aktiviteter på arbetstid.

Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com

För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta Elin Hovbrandt, HR.

Viktig information

Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.

På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.

MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.

MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.

title: Junior Product Designer needed for H&M!
description:
Do you have a passion for fashion, a strong commercial mindset, and an eye for emerging trends? Would you like to work for a globally recognized name in the fashion industry? As a Junior Product Designer, you’ll join a dynamic environment where your creativity and customer focus directly contribute to commercial success!

About the position

Perido is now offering an assignment as a Junior Product Designers with our client H&M. You’ll join an inclusive workplace culture where everyone’s voice is heard, and colleagues treat one another with integrity, respect, humility, and dignity. You’ll work closely with Product Designers and the wider team. The position is based at H&M’s office on Mäster Samuelsgatan in central Stockholm.

Your daily tasks

You will work closely with Product Designers throughout the design and product development process. Your main responsibilities will include:

    Using customer, fashion, competitor, and sales insights to develop the best customer offering
    Supporting Product Designers in developing relevant components and throughout the overall design process
    Creating accurate product specifications (artworks) using relevant 2D or 3D visualization tools to enable an efficient sampling process
    Reviewing prototypes and samples together with Product Designers and revising product specifications as needed
    Maintaining assortment overviews and staying up to date on the departments and category’s goals and strategies

Your characteristics

We’re looking for a motivated team player with a strong customer focus and a good understanding of the target audience. You have a good eye for colour and commercial colour combinations, as well as strong design skills that balance fashion relevance with price, quality, and sustainability. You are driven, flexible, and humble, and you value open communication, collaboration, and taking ownership of your work.

For this position, we ask that you submit your application in English. We look forward to receiving your application!

Qualifications:

    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Fashion Design, or equivalent experience
    Basic knowledge of materials, trims, components, and construction for relevant product types, along with the design skills needed to create commercial products
    Knowledge of applications and software relevant to the design, product development, and production process, including 2D/3D tools
    Excellent collaboration and communication skills

Advantageous:

    Experience with visualization and design using 2D/3D software
    A good understanding of fashion trends, competitor analysis, and sales data

Contract type and hours

Full-time, 6-month consulting assignment, with the possibility extension. Start in November/December.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36012 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

title: Business Controller
description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.  

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?  

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as our Business Controller within one of our business areas. We are looking for someone who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.  

As a Business Controller within Orbital Launch & Rocket Test (OLRT), you will work closely with the Head of OLRT and the leadership team to turn financial analysis into business decisions. Combining hands-on controlling with business partnering, you will evaluate new initiatives, challenge assumptions and help shape a developing business within space launch and rocket testing.

REQUIREMENTS

    A university degree in finance, accounting or a related field.
    Extensive experience in business controlling or similar finance roles, preferably with around ten years of relevant experience in an international environment.
    Experience in a project-based organization, preferably within a larger company, including project reporting and financial follow-up.
    Strong analytical skills, with the ability to model financial outcomes, explain variances and translate findings into practical recommendations.
    Strong practical skills in Excel and Power BI, with confidence in handling and analyzing large datasets.
    Commercial judgement and experience assessing profitability, costs and alternative courses of action.
    Clear communication and strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain financial matters to colleagues outside finance and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.
    A proactive approach, curiosity about the business and experience improving financial processes and ways of working.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning and reporting for OLRT, providing reliable information and clear analysis to support decisions.
    Work closely with the Head of OLRT and the leadership team as a financial business partner and trusted financial advisor.
    Analyze financial performance, identify the drivers behind variances, and recommend actions to improve profitability.
    Monitor project financial performance and work with project managers to identify risks, understand deviations and support corrective actions.
    Develop financial models, scenario analyses and business cases to assess new initiatives and investments under uncertain conditions.
    Evaluate cost alternatives and business opportunities, balancing financial outcomes with operational needs and risks.
    Present financial insights and recommendations in a clear, accessible way to stakeholders across the business.
    Develop and improve financial processes, reporting and analytical tools in collaboration with Group Accounting and Group Business Control.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in either Solna or Kiruna.



FURTHER INFORMATION

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:

Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com

Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com



NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.



WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Accounts Payable Accountant
description:
About us

In 2022, Instabee was founded through the combination of Instabox and Budbee — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy.

Today, Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries, with the ambition to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. We move fast — both when it comes to delivering parcels and growing our business. From Sweden, we have expanded across Scandinavia and into continental Europe, with further growth ahead.

As our business continues to grow, so does the complexity of our financial operations. We are now looking for a full-time Accounts Payable Accountant to join our global Finance team and play an important role in our continued growth.

About the role

As an Accounts Payable Accountant, you will be an important part of our Accounting team, responsible for day-to-day AP activities across our Swedish and international entities. You will help ensure that invoices are processed accurately and on time, payments are handled efficiently, and vendor relationships are well managed.

You will work closely with colleagues across Finance and stakeholders throughout the organisation, giving you broad exposure to our international business. We are on an exciting journey of developing and modernising our current processes, with a strong focus on leveraging AI, and you will play an active part in shaping this transformation.

Your responsibilities

    

Verify, process and record vendor invoices for Swedish and international Instabee entities

    

Ensure invoices are correctly coded, approved and recorded

    

Manage and book vendor payments

    

Perform account reconciliations and follow up on outstanding items

    

Handle vendor queries and invoice- and payment-related questions

    

Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely approvals

    

Support month-end closing, AP reporting and reconciliations

    

Maintain accurate vendor records and documentation

    

Identify opportunities to improve and streamline AP processes

    

Work closely with the Accounting and Controlling teams and support other accounting activities when needed

    

Support the development and improvement of AP processes through the adoption of AI and automation tools

About you

We are looking for a proactive and solution-oriented person with a can-do mentality who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves and get things done.

You have a genuine interest in accounting and enjoy working in a role where accuracy, structure and attention to detail are important. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work well independently and enjoy collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders.

We believe you have

    

A degree or relevant education in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field

    

Previous experience in Accounts Payable or a similar accounting role

    

A good understanding of accounting principles and invoice processes

    

Experience with an ERP or accounting system

    

A structured, detail-oriented and organised approach

    

Strong communication and collaboration skills

    

A proactive mindset and willingness to learn and improve

    

Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is an advantage

What we offer

At Instabee, you will join a talented and collaborative Finance team in a fast-moving international company. You will be trusted with responsibility, challenged to develop your skills and given the opportunity to make an impact. We offer a varied role within our global Finance organisation, exposure to international operations, and the opportunity to help improve our processes as we continue to scale. The journey ahead is exciting for everyone at Instabee — and we are just getting started.

Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:

🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.

🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Dogs are welcome in designated dog-friendly rooms within the office.

🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.

👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.

🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!

⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.

This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

title: Director, Onsala Space Observatory
description:
Chalmers University of Technology is seeking to recruit an outstanding individual to serve as Director of https://www.chalmers.se/en/infrastructure/oso/ (OSO) and lead the Observatory’s continued development as a world-class research infrastructure.

About us

Chalmers University of Technology strives for academic excellence while addressing the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation and applied science.





Chalmers University of Technology hosts Onsala Space Observatory (OSO), Sweden’s national infrastructure for radio astronomy and space geodesy. OSO has a strong link to the https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/physics-and-astronomy/research/aop/ and its broad astronomy research environment. The observatory is also a key part of Chalmers’ wider research and innovation ecosystem, benefiting from strong synergies with complementary infrastructures, such as Myfab for micro- and nanofabrication, Chalmers e-Commons for research data and computing, and the National Academic Infrastructure for Supercomputing in Sweden (NAISS).



OSO supports internationally leading research through advanced facilities and instrumentation in radio astronomy and space geodesy. OSO is also a key partner in major international collaborations, including ALMA, SKAO, EVN, JIV-ERIC and LOFAR ERIC, and is a leading station within the International VLBI Service for Geodesy and Astrometry (IVS). OSO is operated by Chalmers University of Technology with financial support from the Swedish Research Council (VR) and Lantmäteriet (the National Land Survey of Sweden). OSO employs around 50 researchers and research support staff, as part of the Department of Physics and Astronomy.

The Role

As Director of OSO, you will have a central leadership role with overall responsibility for the strategic, scientific and technical activities of the observatory. The role includes responsibility for staff, operations and budgets, as well as developing the organisation and competencies



needed to ensure high-quality operations and strengthen OSO’s long-term scientific development, both nationally and internationally.



An important part of the role is to continue to foster an engaging and attractive environment for employees, researchers and collaboration partners, and contribute to Chalmers’ long-term vision and ambition to be a leading technical university in Europe.

The Director will represent OSO nationally and internationally, with an ambition to further strengthen its scientific profile, secure long-term funding, and develop strategic partnerships with universities, research infrastructures and other stakeholders. The Director will also play a key role in strengthening and developing OSO’s international collaborations.

Working closely with scientific, technical and administrative staff, the Director will lead the continued development of the Observatory’s facilities and research-supporting technologies in radio astronomy and space geodesy.

The Director reports to the Head of the https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/physics-and-astronomy/ at Chalmers University of Technology, as well as to the international OSO Steering Committee. We will provide appropriate support to enable the Director to successfully fulfil the responsibilities of the role.

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

    Academic qualifications at the level of Professor in astronomy, with an internationally recognised scientific track record.
    A broad understanding of the international landscape in radio astronomy, astrophysics and space geodesy.
    Experience in leading and developing research infrastructures, research groups and/or laboratories, preferably in an international environment.
    Experience in managing personnel, budgets and operations in a complex scientific or technical organisation.
    Experience in developing international collaborations.
    Experience with advanced observational facilities, large-scale instrumentation or research infrastructures.

Personal Characteristics

We seek an inspiring and strategic leader who can set clear priorities, delegate effectively and enable others to take responsibility, while building trust and fostering a collaborative, high-performing environment. The successful candidate will combine sound judgement, operational effectiveness and financial responsibility with a strong strategic vision for the observatory and the ability to drive its operational development.

Strong analytical, communication and intercultural skills are essential, together with the ability to build and maintain productive relationships with staff, university leadership, funding agencies and international partners.

Employment terms

The position as Director can be structured in one of two ways: either as a full-time permanent position as Director, or as a permanent faculty position with a fixed-term assignment as Director. The latter option requires an academic review for candidates who do not already hold a faculty position at Chalmers, where the role as Director would then be combined with individual research or teaching up to 20% of full time.

The Director recruitment follows Chalmers’ guidelines for leadership appointments and are carried out by a recruitment committee. The final decision is made by the President.

The position is based at Onsala Space Observatory, in Sweden.



Start date by agreement.



What we offer

Chalmers offers a cultivating and inspiring work environment in the coastal city of https://www.goteborg.com/en/. This position offers a unique opportunity to lead a nationally important research infrastructure with strong international visibility and influence.

Chalmers and OSO provide a dynamic, international and inclusive work environment characterised by openness, collaboration, sustainability and scientific excellence. Equality and diversity are substantial foundations in all activities at Chalmers.

title: Technical Lead
description:
We are looking for a Technical Lead UX Designer specialized in digital accessibility to support

both immediate accessibility audit needs and the development of a scalable

accessibility capability within VG DTO and DxD organization.

The role will focus on evaluating selected applications against WCAG 2.2 AA, identifying

accessibility risks across key journeys, prioritising issues by user impact and severity,

and translating findings into clear remediation guidance for product and engineering

teams.

The ideal candidate goes beyond automated checks. They should be able to conduct

keyboard-only and screen-reader walkthroughs, identify issues that automated tools

miss, review flows, screens and components for accessibility risks, and provide specific,

actionable feedback to other designers. The candidate should help teams design

accessibly from the start rather than retrofit accessibility at the end of delivery.

This is also a capability-building assignment. Over time, the person will contribute to

accessibility methodology, standards, reviews, awareness activities, training guidance,

integration with design-system practices and stronger accessibility ownership across

product teams. The assignment combines senior UX craft, practical audit experience

and an enablement mindset.

The candidate profile:

• Proven experience as a Senior UX Designer with a strong specialization in digital

accessibility and inclusive design.

• Hands-on experience assessing web or digital product journeys against WCAG 2.2 AA

and translating findings into practical design and development guidance.

• Ability to conduct manual accessibility evaluations, including keyboard-only

navigation checks and screen-reader walkthroughs with tools such as NVDA, VoiceOver

or JAWS.

• Ability to use automated accessibility tools as support, while applying human

judgement to issues such as reading order, focus behaviour, labels, announcements,

cognitive load, design consistency and interaction quality.

• Experience reviewing designers’ work and providing clear, specific and actionable

feedback that helps teams ship more accessible solutions.

• Experience prioritising accessibility issues by severity, user impact and delivery

constraints, and converting findings into backlog-ready remediation actions.

• Experience of conducting usability tests with users with disabilities, e.g. people with

visual, cognitive or reading impairments.

• Good understanding of design systems and how accessible components, patterns

and standards reduce repeated remediation work across products.

• Ability to collaborate across UX, product, engineering, compliance/legal and portfolio

stakeholders in a cross-functional operating model.

• Relevant accessibility certification or current training is expected or strongly

preferred: IAAP WAS / CPWA preferred; CPACC, DHS Trusted Tester, W3C WAI training or

equivalent demonstrable experience considered a strong plus.

• Motivation to contribute not only to audits, but also to standards, methodology,

training and awareness activities and capability-building across DxD / DTO.

Min Years: 12

Max Years: no upper limi

title: Students, look here! Finance Support at Oatly
description:
WHY OATLY?

Across the world people’s consumption habits and diets are evolving to be more plant-based. Enter Oatly, the #1 oat based dairy alternative producer in the world with products spanning multiple categories.

We’re determined on being part of the discussion on the long-term future of the food and beverage industry. To keep this movement going, we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the Oatly flowing.

Our sole purpose as a company is to make it easy for people to turn what they eat and drink into personal moments of healthy joy without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process.

Sustainability, nutritional health and trust are at the heart of what we do. We are building a culture that constantly upgrades each other so we can upgrade the planet. This is a company that shows great respect and a fearless approach to make positive change. Does this feel exciting? Well, this is where you come in.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO

As a Finance student, you will participate in the daily processes as well as the closing process at Oatly Accounting shared service E&I (Europe & Internationals) within the Global Accounts Payable Team. You will gain hands-on experience in finance and accounting principles within a supportive team environment.

We are looking for candidates with ongoing or completed studies in Finance or Accounting, which is a requirement for this role. Studies in Tax Law or Information Systems are also highly valued and considered a strong advantage.

As part of the team, your responsibilities will include Accounts Payable task such as:

    

Processing of invoices

    

Assist with month end and quarter end closing activities.

    

Contribute to accounts payable, accounts receivable, and cash management processes.

    

Participate in the preparation and review of balance sheet reconciliations.

    

Support the preparation and maintenance of SOX documentation.

    

Provide support with ad hoc closing and reporting tasks as needed

A lot of corporate-y words, we know! We understand that if you are early in your career, this all might not sound familiar to you. Don't let that stop you from applying – we believe in you!

We looking forward to welcoming you to our team at the HQ in Malmö and embarking on this journey together!

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE

Besides being a good communicator and like numbers, you have an analytic, structured approach and willingness to learn. You are always looking for opportunities for improvement and can handle constant changes!

Some practical things:

    

The position is available immediately, and we're seeking someone who can commit to at least 40 hours per month, with most of the workload around the closing period.

    

We're looking for a pre-graduate in their second or third year of studies. We envision a long-term commitment to the position.

WHO WE NEED YOU TO BEWe think your oatsomeness is built upon the following qualities:

    

You are a passionate advocate for sustainability who strives to create societal shifts and drive the plant-based revolution.

    

You have problem-solving skills essential for identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.

    

You are a self-starter who enjoys building from scratch and implementing sustainable processes, structures, and tools.

    

You are highly collaborative and understand that our success as a company depends on our ability to work together to find innovative solutions.

    

You are an entrepreneur at heart, with the know-how to create forward momentum and the stamina to relentlessly drive the process.

Finally, we hope that you share our values and have a great interest to carry out our mission in order to make the world a little bit better. 

YOUR APPLICATION

Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.

As you can probably tell, we’re a norm-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, let’s do this together! It will be fun!

Last day of application: 22nd October.

We treat all candidates equally: If you are interested, please apply through our application system - any correspondence should come from there. This will ensure that the candidate experience is smooth and fair to everyone!

Love Oatly XOXO

title: Lead Software Engineer to a global tech company
description:
Are you a senior engineer who enjoys building great frontend experiences, improving performance, and shaping the tools and frameworks that help other developers succeed? Do you want to combine hands-on development with technical leadership and explore how AI can make software development more efficient?

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer with a strong frontend focus to help develop shared component libraries, microfrontend infrastructure, and AI-powered tools in a modern product environment. Our client is a global tech company with their HQ is Stockholm.
About the position
You will join a team responsible for a shared component library, microfrontend (MFE) infrastructure, and navigation components used across multiple products. The team also owns parts of the backend and configuration services for a developer platform.

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will take ownership of the component library and MFE infrastructure, ensuring they remain scalable, reliable, performant, and easy for other teams to use. You will also drive AI initiatives that improve frontend development workflows, from code generation to design-to-code solutions. The role is primarily focused on frontend development using React and TypeScript, with some backend development in Node.js and Java.
Following an initial onboarding period of 1–2 months with the current technical lead, you will step into a technical leadership role during their parental leave. This will involve guiding technical decisions, coordinating planning, mentoring engineers, and helping the team maintain momentum. The position follows a hybrid working model, with an expectation of spending approximately one day per week at the Stockholm office. An on-call rotation may also be part of the role.
What You'll Do

    Own the component library: Develop new components, improve styling, address bugs, and ensure accessibility and consistency across products.
    Drive AI-powered development: Build tools and workflows, such as MCP servers, code generation, and design-to-code solutions, that make the component library easier for engineers and designers to use.
    Develop the microfrontend infrastructure: Maintain and improve the MFE framework, support teams adopting microfrontends, and help establish best practices.
    Improve performance: Identify bottlenecks and deliver measurable performance improvements across products.
    Provide technical leadership: Take ownership of technical direction and planning during the technical lead's leave.
    Turn ambiguity into action: Translate loosely defined requests into clear plans, practical solutions, and well-informed technical decisions.
    Balance complexity and value: Challenge unnecessary complexity and suggest simpler alternatives when the expected value does not justify the cost.
    Strengthen reliability: Improve monitoring, logging, and bug reporting to help teams identify and resolve issues more effectively.
    Support the growth of others: Contribute through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

What we're looking for

    7+ years of professional software development experience.
    Strong hands-on experience with React, including hooks, state management, and component design.
    Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library, including accessibility (a11y).
    Solid knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js.
    Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and web performance optimization.
    Experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
    Experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
    Practical experience using AI tools in software development.
    Experience leading, mentoring, or supporting other engineers.

title: Purchasing & Sustainability Administrative Assistant
description:
Role Overview

The Purchasing & Sustainability Administrative Assistant provides administrative and organizational support to Group Purchasing and Sustainability Director.

The main purpose of the role is to ensure that relevant data, documentation, and internal records are accurate, well organized, and kept up to date. The role supports efficient day-to-day operations through reliable administration, data management, reporting, and coordination of internal processes.

Main Responsibilities

    Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Purchasing team.
    Maintain and update purchasing and supplier-related data in internal systems.
    Organize, maintain, and file purchasing-related documents and records.
    Prepare standard reports, lists, and presentations.
    Support the administration and documentation of contracts, certificates, and other relevant information.
    Maintain sustainability and compliance-related documentation.
    Monitor documentation and highlight missing or outdated information for internal follow-up.
    Maintain templates, procedures, and shared Purchasing files.
    Support data collection and compilation for internal reporting.
    Support the standardization and continuous improvement of administrative processes within Purchasing.

Sustainability Administration

    Provide administrative support to the Sustainability function.
    Maintain and organize sustainability-related data and documentation.
    Maintain supplier sustainability and compliance documentation.
    Register and maintain certificates, declarations, questionnaires, and other relevant information.
    Monitor documentation and highlight missing, incomplete, or outdated information for internal follow-up.
    Compile sustainability data for reports, presentations, and internal follow-up.
    Maintain sustainability-related templates, procedures, and shared files.
    Support the coordination and administration of sustainability activities and initiatives.



Scope of the Role

The Purchasing Administrative Assistant is an administrative support function. The role does not include:

    Supplier communication or negotiations.
    Requesting or evaluating quotations.
    Supplier selection.
    Placing orders or managing purchase orders.
    Purchasing or commercial decision-making.
    Responsibility for sustainability strategy or sustainability-related decision-making.

Qualifications and Skills

    Strong administrative and organizational skills.
    Structured, accurate, and detail-oriented way of working.
    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
    Experience with ERP or other business systems is an advantage.
    Interest in purchasing and sustainability topics.
    Good communication and collaboration skills.
    Good written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage in an international organization.
    Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet agreed deadlines.
    Comfortable working with data, documentation, and different internal systems.

Position will in the beginning be 100% in the office. After estimated 3 month will the hybrid part increase.

title: Kyltekniker
description:
